Build: 0/1 Newsstand
Me poor auntie, God rest her soul, left this for me, but whatever would I want it for? I'm sure a cultured one like yerself would appreciate her legacy proppa.
Twas a day like any other, ploughing the fields, when m'boy dug this thing up! You like these, don't ye? Don't worry, we already scrubbed it clean!
Taters for dinner, 'taters for lunch, 'taters for breakfast... I'm so sick of potatoes! Please rid us of the bloody things!
I caught this scamp gobbling all my fish up, but I couldn't bear to hurt it. Will you give him a home?
Huh, what a dimwit! He can't even string two words together! I need someone who's more on my level - a man of the law... A police officer!
He's just so serious! I'd die of boredom with a man like that by my side! Don't you know anyone who knows how to have fun? Maybe someone at the pub?
Oh, the stench, the depravity - no! You really don't get it, do you? I need someone attractive, and intelligent. Fun, yet a true gentleman! A man of the world! Let's check the piers!
My pigs! Gov'nor, you need to help me. See, they've escaped their pen. They're all we got, please get them back!

Hubby's a terrific firefighter, but he has a terrible habit of disappearing after his shift. Last time they found 'im passed out by the pub - and now I'm worried sick he might have fallen somewhere...
Gov'nor! Seen my child? Oh, that little rascal, always getting in trouble with that Spuds kid... If you find him, tell him he's going to be the death of me!

I swear, there's not a single man in this whole town who's fit for me! Look at me! My beauty is far beyond that of these peasants! You know everyone here, don't you? Find me an attractive husband - like a firefighter!
Ma vache! Elle est perdue! Find ma petite Antoinette, I beg of you, she surely doesn't know her way back home...!
Bloody hounds have the whole neighbourhood terrorised. Sooner or later a kid's going to end up bitten! Lock them away, ye must!
Damned wild animals are eating all my hens! Poor things are so terrified they haven't laid an egg in weeks. Please, gov'nor, catch the rascals!
Me pig's been stolen! It's one of the Willington lads I tell ye! See this big 'W' in the mud? Only their fancy boots leave prints like that!
Me livestock! Hubs made fun of me when I told him they were up to summat... They all ran away! Our living depends on them, find them, please!
Oh, how passionate and inspiring! Yes, I shall give this one a chance... For now.
Oi, heard they've sheep with looong necks on t'other side of the world. I'd kill to see one of those!
What a beautiful day for a wedding! Take one of them photographs of the happy couple at the church, will ye?
Me Dorothy and I have been preparing for this the whole year: the Cow Beauty Pageant! Or agricultural fair as the others like to call it... Document this wonderful event, yes?
Me child's a firefighters' fanatic! He wishes to join the local squad when he grows up. It'd mean the world to him if you could take a picture of the firestation to hang by his bedside.
Doctor's told me to stop carrying heavy buckets of water to and fro, but I've many mouths to feed! If only there was a fountain nearby...
There's been another accident with the tools we left laying around, someone's goint to get killed one day! Build a kiosk so we can store them safely, will you?
My father's too old to be ploughing the fields, but he refuses to stay home! A little shade to keep his head cool would go a long way, if you can spare a tree or two around here.
Us farmers have devouted our whole lowly life to harvesting, but none's ever tasted the long yellow fruit they grow in the New World! Wish we could try them at least once in our lifetime...
I once had a taste of that canned food artisans enjoy so much, and I loved it! I wish I were able to afford some of it, if only for my wedding feast...
Neighbourhood had no time to prepare for the winter, and me ma's knee forecasts a specially wicked one this year. Have you some timber to spare for the fireplace...?

I went mushroom picking in the forest and met the most wonderful man, but we were so caught up in the moment that I forgot to ask his name! Do you think I might find him at the pub? Or maybe he's more of a club gentleman...?
I waited for hours, but he never came... I guess we were not meant to be... Still, thank you for caring, yer a true friend.
There he was, like you said! He was so happy to see me as well! We will remember your help, please take this with our thanks.
You know, Guv, I haven't had a thing to complain about in weeks. Not feeling like meself, honestly. I would even like to give you a gift... What's happening to me?
We've so much, Guv, even me orphans are plump. Little Olly just this morning told me "Sir, can I not have some more?". Poor things gave me this for you.
Those dimwits, skipping our union meeting to drink the second I look away... My comrades need to hear my proposal! Lend me your authority to gather them up, Guv.
Me pals, they're so short, you see, they always lose their way to the mines. Good thing is we always make sure to move in a line. Help me find me pals before they miss their shift, yes?
Me young boy's passionate about the worker's struggle! Maybe even too much. See, he's been handing leaflets to his school mates, refusing to be "oppressed by his bedtime".
It's always the same with Old Harold! We arranged our protest on the nineteenth, but out he goes on the ninth all on his own. His bad hearing is going to cost us our reputation! Please shut him up.
Could you point me the way to Ah Sing's house? He's got... good ways of making one forget about the hardships of work. It should be easy to spot by the- er... vapour.
Miss Alethea's concoctions can clear soot clogged lungs in a whim! She lives high up in the mountains tho, and this cough has me too feeble to climb meself...
We dig dig dig dig dig dig dig in our mine the whole day through!
To dig dig dig dig dig dig dig is what we really like to do!
It ain't no trick to get rich quick if you dig dig dig with a shovel or a pick.
In a mine! Where a million diamonds shine! We dig dig dig dig dig dig dig from early morn till night.
We dig up diamonds by the score! A thousand rubies, sometimes more!
But we don't know what we dig 'em for. We dig dig dig a-dig dig, heigh-ho! It's home from work we go.
How am I supposed to brag about punch club if I can't talk about punch club? Oh, I know! The rules didn't say anything about takings pictures! Meet us at the marketplace.

Me mates and I have shared so many moments working at the brick factory... Jimmy's birthday is coming up and there would be no gift more perfect than a framed picture of the place that brought us together.
Can you believe it!? Those pigs won't let us in on their precious club. We'll let them know what they can kiss, those... bourgeois. You might want to have your camera ready!
All this smoke and soot takes a real tool on our bodies. My oldest, she's gotten sick as I've never seen her before. Don't we have a place we can take her to?
Our work clothes get stuck in the machines day in and day out. We spend our nights stitching every rip back together! Sure would be nice to have some of those fancy sewing machines...
These nuveau riche parading their luxuries around while most of us lowly workers have never tasted a single droplet of cocoa! Even things out, boss!
I just became a precious little girl's papa, Guv! We need something fancier to toast just this once, for my baby. You could get us some champagne, right?
The community could use some bonding. Help me organise a good old fashioned barbecue, yes? Just get the sausages and bread and I'll take care of the rest!
So... My mates wanted to see who's stronger and turns out I won, but... I may or may not need bricks to... rebuild something. Please?
Er, is this what champagne tastes like? I'll be sticking to beer then, thank you very much.
It would be wonderful if everyone in my circle were clothed in soft, natural fibres! Such timeless and modest garb would surely be very little trouble to import!
Coffee! It must be how engineers maintain their focus! If I too were worthy of these enchanted beans, I'm sure, given time, I might filter the pre-eminent brew of our age!
Comic opera requires authenticity as much as any theatre, and the audience will jeer if the pirates don't swig rum for the duration...
Steam shall never supersede sail in the imagination! I envision canopies of sail above shell-lined walkways, seascapes, and mariner's paraphernalia...
Woe! I long for a bucolic life! Perhaps some rural farming family might take me in, and share the very precious simplicity of their lives with me?
Erwan Grogg is here! Touring incidental music he composed for a modernist masterwork! If I do not faint, please, I beseech you, will you introduce us? He is sure to be in front of the theatre!

When she's not at church giving the von Tripp children music lessons, my daughter Maria likes to go singing and picking edelweiss in the hills. I do so hate to interrupt her lessons with the children, but I need her here in the workshop!
In the pastry section — a genius. In a new city — a fruitcake! Can you help me find my cousin? He's a huge, bold fellow who never parts from his beer — unmissable!
At the visitor harbour! Surely you have heard of Mr. Joseph Jefferson, tragedian nonpareil?! His brilliance merits the grandest of welcomes!

When I could not see his red smock, I glanced up, and understood my apprentice had gone. He says he prefers to be his own boss, and to make his money at the theater. There are more wealthy people there than there are at my little shop, for sure... (sigh) Perhaps I'm no natural authority figure.
Please! The first days may well test my resolve, but my heart is wild! It shall carry me through!
But I shan't be any burden, I shall be lighter than the country air! And for the dust, I can always wear gloves?
Oh thank you, thank you. Saved indeed, saved!... You don't imagine the labour will be too arduous, do you?

O' for a taste of distant shores and foreign lips, and the elegant shadows of slender leaves... Still, I cannot leave my earthly prison... To see that paradise, if only in a still picture, would take my breath away...
My precious Annabel is about to commence her lifelong voyage of learning! She will shine a light so bright on the world— I must have a picture of her with her fellow pupils!
Please, a photograph of us at the zoo! We may never again have the chance before our little Timothy succumbs to his illness.
The grand opening! Finally, grandfather's canning plan comes true! A picture will inspire my own grandchildren to preserve...ha!...the business forever...
Dubois would take my lovely Rebecca away, but I shall not let him! A photograph of the duel shall prove the lengths to which I am willing to go for her!
I have seen all there is to see! And if the museum ceases to stimulate, I am left with naught but my inner monologue, and little in life terrifies more than that!
This is one of my great favourites! I have long sought a like-minded soul with whom I might share it!
Ah, the turbulence of the past is never quite so dreadful as that of the present! Indeed, I find these ancient artefacts of war quite romantic - and I hope you will too!
It's finally finished! My life's work in art. Dare I dream that by accepting this gift, you intend to make it a centrepiece for the world to admire?
It's my favourite time of the year again - the best craftsmen in town are gathering for the annual artisan fair! Aren't you excited to greet them and contemplate their masterful work?
Oh, the hardships of the lowly life! I... I don't think I am quite fit for this... Please, take this for the loss of time.
These two men claim they are the best poets in the city! Please settle their argument, choose the one you prefer.

Roses are red.

Violets are blue.

Onions stink.

And so do you.

My head is full of random stuff,

Like rusty bread and bits of fluff.

And talking pies with googly eyes,

And stupid stuff that doesn't rhyme.
I really hope this final prototype will function correctly outside of a laboratory... Perhaps you'd be willing to put it through its paces?
These seeds are the product of years of painstaking plant grafting in our botanical nurseries. This crop should now grow on your island as if in its natural climes!

It is far too common to see the poor suffer ill health, whether from smoking chimneys, or the miasma of the mines! One of my esteemed peers has dedicated their life to curing people of their illnesses. If you have a position available, I'm sure they would work wonders!

Charles Darwin, one of the greatest minds of the century is in town! He has been conducting studies about evolution but some of his experience subjects have escaped and are running in the city. If you help him I am sure he would agree to work for you. Start with the fishes close to the harbour!
Great! That's the first animal of his experiment! Could you find his crocodiles now?
Wonderful! Just need the baboon and we are all set!
I just spoke to mister Darwin, he is thrilled to work with a patron so understanding as you. He agrees to move in the city!

All these children, sent to the factories as soon as they learn to walk! Such a pity! A child should have a chance to learn to read and acquire skills! Please, convince some workers parents that this is the best for their child, I am willing to teach them for free.
Mmh, I can send her my child but there is no way that I am feeding this useless mouth, she will have to take care of it as well!
What a wonderful opportunity! I wished I had the same when I was a child.
Leaning is the best way for my daughter to understand the pressure classes put on us and fight them effectively!
I do need the money my daughter brings by going to the factory but if this allow her to do better than me in life ...
Teaching to children? What a weird idea, mine learnt everything she had to know by living the real life!
What is she? Some kind of Jean Valjean? Fair enough, let her take care of my son but she better not complain when he will do his usual shenanigans.

I have been exchanging for months with a man who calls himself El Professor. He is so intelligent, he seems to always know what I am going to say before I even say it! And now he is coming in the city! I promised I would make him visit the bank. Could you pick him up?
Thank you! He loved the bank, he said he will visit it with friends of his soon!
People who keep exotic pets, and fail to care for them, seldom realise the damage they do to native animal populations! We must catch the invaders before they have chance to take hold!
Could you take a photograph of us in front of the University, please? My daughter has studied eleven hours a day, for five solid years to reach this moment!
Because I'm a woman, many question if the breakthrough really is mine. As such, it gives me the greatest pleasure to be photographed beside the steam shipyard where my new engine will be used.
The workers presume I am too fancy to get my hands dirty. But I value field work greatly! A photograph of me visiting the Concrete Factory shall prove it!
I wonder what would happen if we tried to photograph a train in motion? The exposure will likely make it a blur, or a smudge at best, but why don't we conduct a little test!
I am hosting an academic symposium for my co-authors, and I need to feed them all. Experts say fish is good for the brain — please, deliver some to my home?
It seems we have no time to cook the fish, at least in part because we can't reach consensus on the best method. Perhaps you could bring us some of the tinned stuff instead?
My sand-themed paper cannot present a single unifying theory without the support of experimental evidence! I will need materials!
With so much still to be discovered, we cannot afford to rest! If recent health research is to be believed, my colleagues and I have little to fear from our coffee indulgences!
We are presently trying to teach chimps and bonobos to perform human tasks, and would like a fleet of bicycles on which we can wheel them to the park. Would you be able to help?

Most people still fear the light bulb! They think they'll be electrocuted if they touch one! Well, let's bring them out of the dark ages. Help me organise an eastern festival of light, with an undercurrent of education!
People of the New World worship me. Hmm...
Everywhere I go, people seem to look through me. Hmm...
An imperfect sphere, white with light; I grow in the darkness, the lady's delight. Hmm, what is it?
Break a piece of me off, and I can provide shade. What am I?

When they are green, and when they are brown, their bendy mien will cause me to frown. But split in between, for a very short while, they're joyfully yellow and cause me to smile!

What am I?
I'm fastest on a full belly, and it sounds like I'm going cheap. What am I?

I stop, it keeps running.
What is it?
As the holding company, about time you received some additional benefits, eh? Take some surplus product!
An associate has bailed on me at the crucial moment. Perhaps you want these gramophones, at a fraction of the usual price?
I brought this back from the last trip, but it really does not befit our mantelshelf as I thought it would. Please, you keep it!
Productivity— keyword of our time! Use this machine! It will never ask a wage, be indolent, or show up late!
The exhibition opening has been a ripping success! Cause for celebration— one I should be honoured to sponsor!
I'm always looking to gain an advantage over the competition! Convince them to back-off, and I predict the markets will pick-up.
Wood flammable? Hmmn, yes I suppose that is a safety risk, maybe I will invest elsewhere...
You're right, I am stressed. And a holiday might keep the whole family quiet for a while...
Involved in shady dealings you say? Then I owe you my thanks, and shall withdraw from the deal immediately!
I wish to form an investment consortium— and what with so many affluent visitors in the city...any chance you might 'hook us up'?
Oh no, I'm terribly sorry, we blew all of our family fortune on this holiday...
With a fellow notorious for his disreputable business practices? Never!
That sounds a lucrative proposition indeed! I shall accept forthwith!
Never mind if Christmas is coming, he shall not have a day off! Where is the fool anyway? Made destitute by his thriftless present-giving perhaps?!
Mr Scrounge may seem miserly, but I am certain a candle of charity burns yet in his heart. I shall wish him greetings of the season as I would any other!
Bah! Humbug! What reason has he for being so merry?! I am by far the richer, and yet I find that season abhorrent!
If we are to drag this place out of the mire, we need talent. Talent I say! If only we could prise some quality away from Sir Archibald's offices of state...
Dashed sorry old chap, but I'm a royalist through and through!
For some upstart business nonsense? Are you mad? I work for the Queen!
Yes! I will join you. After all, I have always been royally undervalued here...
The dratted news boys are delivering yesterday's paper to our subscribers! Quick! Collar them before the Financial Express becomes a laughing stock!
He was cavorting through the streets in his underwear! Goodness knows how he arrived at such a state of undress, but he must be stopped!
Poor, gentle Nelson... He can't have gone far! My little kitty loves the member's club - maybe he's there, hoping to catch a few morsels of food?
Every impecunious old family seems to be courting my riches with offers of marriage. A few snaps will ensure I'll get more than just a title—if you know what I mean...
A solid, industrious frame, but too ancient! No, this old family factory is a lost cause!
Ugh! What tired and tumbledown features! I see no prospects here.
Oh yes, wowzer! I think we've hit the jackpot. That factory looks ideally situated.
Mister Jenkins is the one, I'm sure of it! I pursued him by foot as far as the public mooring... What business could he have there but to be trading my secrets with mafiosi!?
All they do is complain about being poor! What of hard work? If I did it from nothing, so can they, a photograph of me can prove it!
I am smiling for the first time in decades! You must take a photograph! The spirits have shown me the way— oh what a fool I was! I shall give my employee and his family a Christmas to remember!
A statue of me will galvanize the layabouts of this city into action! Productivity will soar, and so will profits!
What do you take me for? Think I want to mix with the plebeians in a grotty tavern? No! I want membership of an elite club, and to garner social influence!
This week has me bored stiff, and I don't have time to work out how to relax. Entertain me! Spoil me with the novel, the exotic, the exquisite!
Are you quite mad, sirrah? Who doesn't already have a gramophone?!
I'm the one who needs to blow off steam! I don't need an engine to do it for me!
Well no surprise in the end, but ever a winner. You know me well! Gold is the one thing I shall never tire of.
These charity gala are crucial to do business but annoyingly I need to give to charity to attend. Deliver supplies to "Indigent order" on my behalf, you would be sweet.
Fine, they were happy with the delivery. You don't mind me saying I paid for these right?
Everyone who's anyone will be at this party, Better make sure the horses get their apples— and this is a whole herd of prime mustang we're talking about!
I'm trying to corner the executive lunch rush with these corn flaps from across the water, but I'm going to need a bally sample batch...
My darling granddaughter is the only one capable of bringing tears to my eyes. I only hope showering her with gifts will make up for any difficulty I have expressing these feelings.
Eh, you know what this is? I went for a walk in the mountains and found my paca nibbling on it. Go on, take it, it's not like I need it.
Young lads will go through their lives without ever knowing a good day of honest labour. Bring me them kids so I can teach them what real work looks like!
Ha, with those scrawny shoulders he couldn't even lift a sickle!
Oh... o-ok, I guess...
Pfft, who cares!
Nan.
Sure ...
I... I asked my grandson to help me write something for an... old acquaintance from El Puerto. Just... you just hand it over, yes?
Did she say something? ...No, I don't want to know. I just hope she understands...
The alpacas are loose, master! No no no, how could this happen!? Help this old man gather his flock back, por favor!
This weather, boss... I swear I never saw animals behave like this. Los cocodrilos, for example, are getting dangerously close to town. Something must be done before a kid gets hurt...
Pearl-diving has always been a dangerous job, trust me, I've been doing it since I was a muchacho. But we never had as many problems with the sharks as we do now. Think you can chase them away?
My nieto, Miguel, said he was going to visit his abuelita for El Día de los Muertos. But boss, my Antonia passed away years ago! And Miguel still hasn't returned...
Ever since my nieta María fed and sheltered that crook Bill, she keeps mumbling something about a grotto in the pirate island. Hell if I know what you will find there...
Lama lamaaamasticot lamamasticot! Lama lama masticot lamasticoooot!
Well, here we are. Didn't your editor want a picture of us "busy bees of the New World"? To think people waste their time with these petty distractions...
My bones get heavier and heavier with each passing day... I would like to have my picture taken. You know, for the family altar, but... We are very poor, boss. You have a picture machine, sí...?

When I was a young boy my father took me sailing with him every day. The sea mist, the sails in the wind... I miss it all as much as I miss him.If I had but a picture to bring back all these memories with my pa...
No wonder our youths have completely forsaken our values when we don't have a church to spread the gospel truth!
My cousin Pablo lost his home to the flames. They have nowhere to stay... If you could only build a new house for them, our entire familia would be forever grateful, boss.
Nothing brings us jornaleros as much joy as stroking a sweet guitar. I used to be a luthier back in the day, if you bring me wood, I can make one for everyone.
My grandkids keep pestering me to play with them. And I'm not the only one, kids here seem to be utterly bored. With some alpaca wool I could make plush toys for them.

I remember my mamá cooking for the whole neighbourhood, spreading the joy with her homemade fried plantains. I would like to honour her memory by doing the same, if you can spare some plantains and oil.

There are rumours of a child striving to survive in the wilderness! People say a bear and a panther look after him, but those are no conditions to live in! Could you find him for me? I will take good care of the poor thing.

A gang of horribly corrupter police officers are extorting the good people of this town and beating people up when they refuse to comply. They have threatened me too, but not speaking up against injustice is against my nature!
The jornaleros at the corn field, they are so hard-working... Too much for their own good! They need to take their legally required break! They won't listen to us, but I know they'll listen to you.
Help! My friends has been abducted by La Fortune's brutes! She must be somewhere on his island! Please, I beg of you, bring her back!
The war has left many orphans behind... I am committed to doing as much good as I can in the world. If you see a child on the streets, will you send them to me? I will look after them.
Gratitude is so often taken for granted... We have decided to give good where good is due. I know it's a small thing, but we wanted to celebrate everything you've done for us with a present.
Our family gathers every week to have a lunch together, but there's always so much food left over! I hate to see it all go to waste. Please, take it and share it with the ones in need.

The bridge you have set between our continents is unprecedented! I have learned so much from your Old World, I would love to contribute to spread the knowledge about our culture there as well! Could you take this and set it on display?

Nana Angustias passed away and left me her wedding jewellery set, but I don't need it, really. I know it's worth something, though, so could you put it to use to help the less fortunate? It's what she would have wanted.

Today marks the first year anniversary of the rise of our revolution. Your editor wants to feature us freedom fighters in a commemorative article, and since you have been such an inspiration for us it would mean a lot if you could take the snapshot.

We are all so proud of all the exemplary improvements you have done here, as should you! Wouldn't it be perfect to celebrate this town with a feature article in your newspaper? It may encourage more people to emigrate to join us!

Our society has come such a long way in the past few years! Now a woman can pursue a career in medicine and have her own income and independence without it being frowned upon. My colleagues and I want to set an example for generations to come — could you showcase a picture of us in your newspaper?

We are lucky enough to be living times of peace, but many of my comrades are still fighting against the grip of La Corona. They require weapons, but it would be too risky for you to smuggle them yourself. If you entrust me with the supplies, I could sent them to my comrades through our underground network!
Many of our comrades are still fighting against La Corona, but their supplies are running low and hunger is starting to wear them down... If you can spare some food, I can make sure it gets to them.

Most can't imagine how cold nights can get in the open, even if it's warm in daylight. I will never forget the freezing nights when we were running from La Corona. If you can spare some alpaca wool, I can make blankets to send the refugees.
It is a real shame that children here have to be home schooled. The experience of sharing knowledge is lost on us. If only we had a museum, we could turn it into a shrine of culture.
We have fought long and hard to be rid of tyranny, now is the time for democracy! We need to elect our own representatives, and they can only work from a town hall.
Ah, the classics of literature! I abhor the thought of people going about their whole lives without ever reading a page. We need to spark the love for the written word! How about a book exhibition?
There are still so many war refugees knocking at our doors, Gobernor. If you were to house them, I am sure they would be more than happy to join our flourishing community!

All this running around your city has left me starving! It sure is beautiful here - but how can I enjoy anything with a rumbling stomach? Ah, if only I could savour the view with a juicy piece of local meat!

Ahh, that was wonderful! My brain's running a lot better now it's all greased up, if you catch my drift. My name is Dennis Brammen, and I guess you could say I'm a content creation specialist. I know exactly what you need to get your city the likes it deserves. I'll write a cool article for your newspaper - just take a picture of your deliciously plump piggies!

Now that's what I call a partnership! I like you, buddy. You "get" my sophisticated palate - and your place isn't too bad either! I've invited my whole group of friends to come over - they'll love it here! Come on, let's join them at the pub!
This is the yummiest fish I've ever put in my mouth! But let's face it - fish is barely an appetiser, right? Keep it coming!
Damn, that wurst was awesome - what an explosion of flavour! Now, I think it's time for the main course. I hear your beef's been praised far and wide for its high quality!
Darn right, that's the stuff!! So juicy and tender, it melts in the mouth... It just needs a nice, crispy brown toast on the side.

My great passion is fashioning costumes to help bring the past to life! If only I had real images to work from, my designs could be all the more authentic! Perhaps you could photograph some museum exhibits from the old northern kingdoms, or even our long-lost ancestors from the Bronze Age for me?
Such unbelievable wonders! I'm so inspired now, I need to design some new clothes! Still, I do feel I'm missing something... A breath of fresh air... Or rather, warm air!

It's perfect! After studying this picture and your museum meticulously, I have come up with a new design - something I believe has never been done before in the world of fashion. But I need materials from the source... Oh, if you could bring some to me!

I am so thrilled to have created a piece that brings together the cultures of both the Old and New World! You've helped me so much, I would love to repay you by spreading my expertise among your people!

Those extinct animals you keep are so majestic — magical even. This giant deer, for instance, is certain to canter across the pages of my new fiction. Still, further research is needed, and I need a place to write the thing! Would you happen to have any suggestions?

Those are some astonishing animals you have there! I intend to write a story which depends upon real and factual observations of the deep seas — and as such, I enjoy any challenge to my misconception of the creatures that dwell therein. Perhaps you have more maritime curiosities you could share with me?

The other writers believe it to be fiction, but I am going insane! Something both terrible and terrific lies beneath our feet, in the abyss, trapped in the ice. A cult devoting itself to the same monstrous deity is gathering in the New World — I must be present to document our end! Bring me pictures and artifacts, and build a hospital to care for those plagued by the coming darkness!
A farmer's aunt has passed away, leaving her niece a very nice heriloom. Unfortunately, it has no practical use. She would like you to keep it instead.
This farmer's son found something buried in the dirt. She thought you would like to have it.
This farmer has had a very good harvest of potatoes. So good they have too many! She thought you could put the surplus to good use.
This fisherwoman caught a seagull feasting on her hard work. She wants to put it in your custody.
This farmer's pigs have escaped their pen and now roam the streets of your city! Help her catch them, they are all she has in the world!
The farmer's husband has a record of disappearing and drinking himself to sleep in the streets. She's worried something bad might have happened to him.
The farmer's son is a renouned scoundrel and she has lost track of him yet another time. She's worried he might be getting in trouble again and requested your help to find him.
This farmer girl has troubles finding a suitable companion to match her colourful personality. She has requested you help her find a worthy suitor.
This farmer is very close to her cow Antoinette. She is nowhere to be seen and her owner is worried sick. She has asked for your help to find her old friend.
This farmer worries the stray dogs will hurt the neighbourhood children if you do nothing to prevent it. She requests that you lock them away.
Wild animals are hunting the farmer's hens! She begs you to catch them before they eat all her chickens up.
Farmer had her pigs stolen by one of the Willington's brothers. She needs help identifying which one is guilty.
The farmer's animals have escaped and she seems to believe they somehow planned it. Find them around town, they are all they have!
The farmer really wants to see the alpacas of the New World. You can take a picture of them and send it her way! She will surely be grateful.

The most curious bond is being blessed at the Church: Montanes and Capitules, lifelong enemies, are now united by the wedding between their first borns. A picture would set the memory fast in their memories, so they never go back to their old quarrels.
The Agricultural Fair is a very special event for farmers, especially this one and her cow! She has asked that you take a picture of the fair for your newspaper.
The firefighters are this farmer's son's heroes. Encourage his dream of becoming part of the squad taking by his picture in front of the fire station.
This farmer is working very hard to provide for her family. Having a fountain nearby would really lift a heavy burden from her shoulders.
Farming tools are dangerous! A few accidents have already stemed from not storing them properly. The farmer would like to have a kiosk to safely put them away.
This farmer's father refuses to retire despite his old age. She has asked that you plant a tree near the field so he can at least get some rest from the sun.

This farmer is terribly committed to her craft and would like to learn more about agriculture in other shores. She has requested you bring plantain from the New World for her and her colleagues to taste.
A farmer would like canned food for her wedding feast.
The farmer is very worried that her family and neighbours do not have enough firewood to last the whole winter. She has asked you for some timber.
Farmer asks for help finding the mysterious man she met in the forest.
A farmer wants to give you a quest.
A life without worries is starting to get to this worker. He even has a little something for you, who would have said!
The orphans in your town are perfectly healthy and well-fed, they wanted to thank you with a little present.
This worker's colleagues do not take their union meetings as seriously as he does. He would like your help to find them around town and make them attend.
These miners are a close gang, they go everywhere in a line. But not even that prevents them from getting lost in their way to the mines. They'll be in troble if they miss their shift again.
This worker's son is a true revolutionary! So much that he gets his father in trouble. He would like to help to find him and get him to go to bed.
This worker's colleague seems to be causing his union a lot of trouble by revolting on the wrong date. He would like you to find him and disperse his one-man protest discreetly.
This worker has had a very long day and would like to relax at Ah Sing's. He looks a bit disoriented, but you should be able to spot the place easily by the puffs coming out the windows.
Soot and smoke are an essential part of a worker's daily life, but they can always count on Miss Alethea's remedies. Provided they can climb to her house in the mountains...
This worker desperately wants everyone to know about his after-work activities. Unfortunately, the rules explicitly forbid talking about it... but not taking pictures of it.
These brick factory workers are very close pals. They've asked you to take a picture of the workplace that brought them together as a gift for their friend Jimmy.
This worker wants to protest against the investors for rejecting him at the club, and it looks like he has a peculiar method in mind. He has asked you to take a picture of the... occasion.
This worker's daughter has fallen ill due to the pollution from the factories. He asks you to build a hospital so she can be taken care of.
The workers have to mend their work clothes every day. They have asked you for sewing machines to make their lives easier.
Social inequality is a big concern for this worker. That's why he would like you to bring some chocolate for them!
This worker just had a baby girl! They want to toast to her with something classier than a pint of ale, but they cannot afford champagne with their salary...
The worker would like to organise a barbacue to bring the neighbourhood together. He has requested you provide the sausages and bread.
Looks like this worker is the sad winner of a very destructive competition. He has asked that you lend him some bricks to fix the results of his victory.
A worker wants to give you a quest.
An artisan begs you to supply them with some fine woollen ponchos.
Artisans find it hard to concentrate on anything without freshly-milled coffee, and hope you may be able to supply it.
An artisan would like you to supply his touring pirate musical with enough rum for its entire run of shows.
An artisan hopes you might supply him with sails for some sort of as-yet-undefined art-fair-cum-maritime-forum he has spontaneously conceived.

A wistful Artisan believes he is ready to take up the plough, and leave the city behind. He hopes you might find a farming family willing to take him on until he is confident enough to instruct himself.
An Artisan has come to you asking to meet the renowned composer who is passing through the city. Perhaps something can be arranged.
Maria is a fervent churchgoer, and music enthusiast, who is teaching the von Tripp children to sing. However, her father needs her back at his workshop.
An Artisan comes to you with news his cousin, a notable pastry chef, has wandered off. If he knew where he was, such a suggestible soul might easily be convinced to work for you!
An Artisan comes to you, anxious you may have overlooked the presence of an acclaimed tragic actor in your city. Massaging the thespian's fragile ego with a welcome may prove mutually beneficial!
An Artisan was too caught in his own dreamworld to keep track of his apprentice, who, having once again shirked his duties, must be found.
An artisan would like a picture of El Puerto.
An Artisan would like a photograph of his daughter's first day at school, so that she might one day see how her journey to enlightenment began.
An Artisan would like to be photographed alongside his extensive family on the special occasion of their visit to the Zoological gardens.
An Artisan would like the opening of his cannery photographed, so that his scions may remember the day with pride.
An Artisan would like you to photograph a fistfight between him and a rival for the affections of Rebecca, his apparently unrequited love.
An artisan says they've seen all there is to see at your museum, and that they hope a new exhibition will open soon.
An artisan offers you a book he imagines you might enjoy.
An artisan would like to present you with a set of ceremonial arms. They once belonged to warriors of antiquity, and were discovered during a recent amateur excavation.
An artisan has been moved to present you with a personal masterwork of his own creation!
An artisan advises you to visit the Annual Artisan Fair.
Artisan would like you to choose who is the best poet.
An Artisan wants to give you a quest.
An engineer would like to you to test her latest invention.
An engineer is offering you seeds to help grow non-native crops on one of your islands.
An engineer recommends you enlist the services of her colleague: a doctor determined to improve living conditions in your city.
Engineer would like to teach to Workers' children to grant them a better life.
Engineer would like you to meet with El Professor, a man who whishes to visit the city bank.
An Engineer would like you to help Charles Darwin conduct his study on evolution.
An engineer would like you to stop the Shelley couple from pulling pranks on gullible townsfolk.
An engineer would like you to find the exotic animals that are roaming your island, as she worries they may harm the local wildlife.
An emotional engineer would like you to photograph her daughter at her university on graduation day.
An engineer would like to have her photograph taken to revel in her success as a naval engine-builder.
An Engineer would like to have her picture taken in front of the Concrete Factory.
An engineer would like you to attempt to photograph a train in motion.
An engineer requests plenty of tallow and quartz sand for her latest experiment.
An engineer would like you to supply her department with coffee.
An engineer would like to cater for her academic peers, since she is hosting a forum for scientific research.
An engineer would like to commission a fleet of Penny Farthings for the Institute of Primate Research.
An engineer would like to prove the benefit of electric lighting to people by arranging the new-fangled bulbs in a public display.
An engineer would like you to solve her enigma.
An engineer would like you to solve her enigma.
An engineer wants to give you a quest.
An investor would like to give you a gift for all your support.
An investor would like to sell you a fleet of spangly gramophonographs for the discounted price of 100,000 coins.
An Investor wants to give you a souvenir from his travels he has no interest in anymore.
An Investor would like to offer you a machine to improve factory efficiency.
Delighted by its success, an Investor would like to sponsor the after-party of your grand exhibition with some luxury goodies.
A newspaper mogul faces ridicule if you don't stop his couriers delivering the old editions they took by mistake. He says the paper is popular in the financial districts.
The Investor has sighted a lewd interloper revealing himself in public in the neighbourhood. You had better catch him, or all these repressed prudes may start doing it!
The investor has lost his darling kitten! Help him find the poor, defenceless little mog.
Investor would like you to convince his competitors to leave the business.
An investor is looking for a business partner, and thinks the influx of visiting wealth in the city might be a good chance to hook-up with like-minded entrepreneurs.
Mr Scrounge would like you to find his employee, so that he can inform him he will be working through Christmas.
An investor has come to you bemoaning the dearth of talent in the city. He comes to you asking you to scout around in Sir Archibald's circles.
An investor believes his employee Mr Jenkins to be divulging industrial secrets to a nefarious third party, and wishes for photographic proof of the underhand dealings before taking action.
A wealthy investor would like his photograph taken, believing his rags-to-riches story the perfect example for those in poverty.
A wealthy investor would like photographic previews of his marriage offers, in order to decide which noble bloodline to marry into.
Investor would like a picture of him and his employee's family celebrating Christmas.
An investor would like you to pay homage to his industriousness with a statue in his likeness. He believes his example can be an inspiration to others.
The investor is sick of having to look at poor people when he comes into town, and would like you to build a club so he can shoot billiards with his public school chums.
An Investor wants an avalanche of champagne and cigars for a monumental house party.
An investor would like to experience the most marvellous indulgences the world has to offer, pamper him with luxury!
An investor hopes to bring tortilla to the old world masses. But he needs some samples to see if they'll prove a hit.
An Investor seeks a fitting gift for his granddaughter's birthday, but feels completely out of touch. Can you help him?
An investor would like you to donate to a charity on his behalf.
An Investor wants to give you a quest.
Jornalero would like you to listen to the story of his life.
This jornalero was taking his usual walk in the mountains when his alpaca found something curious...

This jornalero is very worried about his granchild Miguel, who has not returned home. The last time they saw him, he said he was off to visit his deceased grandmother. Maybe a place of mourning is the best place to start looking.
Jornalero would like to pass on his knowledge to kids.
The alpacas have escaped their pen and now run wild all around town! Help the jornalero gather them back before someone is hurt.
Climate changes have affected the behaviour of the wildlife. This jornalero is very concerned about some crocodiles that lurk not far from the city.
Some sharks are terrorising the pearl divers and making their job more dangerous than it already is. They have asked you to take care of the pest.
Jornalero hope you can give a letter to a woman he once knew.
This jornalero granddaughter helped a criminal, and it would seem like, in exchange, he had a secret for her. It has to do with a grotto in a pirate island. What could it be...?
Your editor wants to feature the hard working jornaleros for the next edition of the newspaper and has asked them to pose for you. Take the snapshot whenever you are ready.
This jornalero would like to have a picture for their family to leave at his altar once he is gone, but he cannot afford a photographer. He has kindly asked you to do it for him.
This jornalero has asked you to take a picture of a sail ship, as it would remind him of his childhood sailing with his father.
The depravity of the newer generations! This jornalero would like you to preserve their traditional principles by building a church.
Pablo's home was burnt in the last fire. His cousin has asked you to build a new house for him and his family.
This jornalero would like to bring his share of happiness to the community by building guitars for everyone. He only needs the wood to make them.
As annoying as playing with his grandchildren might be for this jornalero, he still has a soft side. He would like you to bring him some alpaca wool to make plush toys for all the children in town.
This jornalero would like to cook for the whole neighbourhood as his mother used to do in her memory.
A jornalero wants to give you a quest.

Rumour has it that there is a child living in the jungle only with a bear and a panther for company. This obrera has asked you to find him and bring him to her so she can take proper care of the child.
An obrera has informed you about a case of police corruption in your town. You should find the crooked officers and end the situation at once. According to what you've heard, they are quite violent.

The jornaleros who work at the corn field are working so hard it is becoming a threat to their health! An obrera is worried about them and has asked you to go there and reassure them that it is not only ok but required that they take a small break every once in a while.
This obrera is very worried about her missing friend. Apparently, she has been kidnapped by La Fortune's pirates. She has asked you to find her at his island.
This obrera is worried about the orphans in the streets. She would like to take care of as many as she can. If you see any homeless children, you can tell them to go to her.
The obreros are so thankful to you for fulfilling their dreams of a better world that they would like to give you a present.
This obrera has a lot of leftovers from her family's gathering and she would like to share it with those who might need it instead of throwing it all away.

This obrera is passionate about knowledge, and she would like you to teach the people overseas about the rich culture of the New World. That's why she wants grant you a relic from her native culture so that you make it part of your museum exhibitions.
This obrera's grandmother passed away and left her a beautiful piece of jewellery, but she'd rather you have it, and use it to help the poor.
The editor wants to write an article about the one-year anniversary of the success of the obreras revolution, and they have asked that you take the picture for the article.
This obrera believes your town is perfect and deserves the attention of your newspaper. She has suggested you take a picture of the island to appear in the next edition of your newspaper.

Times have fortunately changed, and it is completely normal for women to be employed in respected professions, such as doctors. The obreras are very proud of being part of this shift in society, and would love to appear in your newspaper to set an example for future generations.

Many obreros are still fighting for the Revolution against La Corona, but they lack weapons. If you were to send them yourself, they would be intercepted and used against them, but this obrera can use her contacts to make sure they arrive at their destination.
The people of the revolution are still fighting La Corona's yoke, but they are low on supplies and need your help. This obrera can help supply them with food if you can deliver some to her.

Even in the tropical weather, nights are very cold in the New World. This obrera cannot forget all the people running away from La Corona and would like to make blankets for them if you give her some alpaca wool.
This obrera believes the community would greatly benefit from having a shared place in which to share knowledge and culture. That's why she has asked you to build a museum on the island!
The obreros have reminded you that democracy demands an appointed institution. That is why they have asked you to build a town hall in the island.
This obrera would love to have a book exhibition at the museum to inspire her love for literature to the community.
The war with La Corona leaves many new refugees every day. This obrera has suggested you build more houses for them to move into your island.
An obrera wants to give you a quest.
A curious visitor has arrived at your moorings, with the intention of taking a big bite out of your city's wonders.

The visitor introduced himself as Dennis Brammen, a content creation specialist who says he can amass plenty of subscriptions for your newspaper, if you'll just take a picture of one of your pig farms to run alongside his article.
Dennis' article was a complete success! He's come to like you and your island a lot, so he's invited his whole group of friends to visit as well. Help him find them at the pub!
A passionate artisan has asked you to take a picture of an exhibit in your museum that belongs to the Northern Saga or Bronze Age collections.
The artisan is inspired by the museum photographs, and has a new design in mind. However, he feels he needs a little more inspiration from the New World.
The artisan has designed a revolutionary piece of clothing, but he requires some materials from the New World in order to turn it into reality.

A disillusioned university scholar has been inspired to write a fantasy novel after visiting your zoo. He will reward you generously if you help him write this ambitious and weighty work of escapism. Provide him with some stimulating items to study, and a place to work in peace.

Though fascinated by The Rings of the Kings, an enthusiastic writer has decided he'd prefer a pinch more science with his fantasy. He would like to explore the unknown depths of the oceans with his fiction. Help him find some reference material on the world beneath the sea, so he can write a best-seller.

A pale and peculiar man approaches you after the recent publication of an undersea science-fiction novel. He appears increasingly paranoid about the shadows and monsters, whose return he believes has been foretold in a cult book of mysteries from the New World. Help him find it, before he loses all sanity.
Look for the pigs walking the streets of your city.
The farmer's husband is most likely at one of the local pubs.
Look for the farm animals running around the streets of your city, probably near the farmers' residences.
Look for the dogs running around the streets of your city, probably near the farmers' residences.
Look for the wild animals running around the streets of your city, probably near the farmers' residences.
Look for a potential husband for the farmer near the fire stations, police stations, pubs or shipyards.
Attractive lads will probably be surrounded by an admiring crowd.
Alpacas live in the New World.
The wedding is taking place at a church in your city - look for the cheering crowd!
The workers are likely to be having a blast at one of your pubs.
The boy is handing out flyers in one of your schools. He's wearing a blue shirt.

The lady is teaching children to sing at the church.
The cook is exploring the market, wearing a white apron.
The tragic actor is being praised at the public mooring.
The apprentice with the red shirt is selling lemon juice next to the theatre.
Groups of farmers might be found around a church, a market or a pub.
Take a photo of any of your trading posts in the New World.
The duel is taking place near one of your churches.
Build a museum (if you don't have one already), place one module and equip it with an item.
Museum items can usually be found on expeditions, or can be bought from traders.
Look for exotic animals running around the streets of your city, probably near the engineers' residences.
Trains run along railways, transporting the oil required to create electricity.
An ancient people worshipped this golden crop, as it kept them from starvation.
What commodity is so transparent you can see right through it?
What is small, round and white, and is used by women as jewellery?
A black shard that you can also use for drawing and adding shadows to your paintings.
What is yellow and yummy, but not quite so delicious when it's green or brown?
What makes a ship go fast when it's full?
An accessory that continuously runs, even when the person carrying it stops.
Paperboys are standing on carts, calling for the attention of passersby at the bank.
Look for the worker running in his undergarments around the streets of your city, probably near the workers' residences.
Select the box next to the Investor to purchase Grammophones from him at a very low price.
Select the box next to the Investor to receive the goods he's offered.
The strange deal, between two men in costume, is taking place at the public mooring.
Look for the investor's pet near the member's club.
The child is looking for help at one of your chapels.
The sharks can be found close to the pearl farm.
The alpacas are walking around on your island near their farm.
The crocodiles are roaming the streets of your island.
You can find the family posing for the picture near one of your chapels.
The clipper is the only trading ship with four masts. It is the longest unarmed sailing ship around.
The boy is close to a mining slot, accompanied by a panther and a bear.
Look for corrupt police officers near the boxing arena.
The jornaleros can be found near one of your farms.
The obreros can be found posing for their photo near a museum.
Take a photo of a town hall on your island.
The obreras can be found posing for the photo near one of your hospitals.
Equip the items Heimskringla, The Iliad and The Odyssey in your museum.
All these items can be found on expeditions.
Sir Archibald is hugely embarrassed, and asks for your help.
Sir Archibald Blake has a matter of titanic personal embarrassment to discuss with you. He hopes that you can help him make up for lost time.

Archie has somehow lost the sketchbook of esteemed naval architect Rohit Bhargava, who had been ready to present plans for a colossal ship to the Queen. All is not lost however — with but a few photographs of the World's Fair to inspire him, he may be able to draw them up afresh.

I have lost Mr. Bhargava's plans for the Great Eastern — delaying her launch yet further! The taxpayers are begging to see the dream come alive, but first the prototypes hit every hitch, and now this! Poor Rohit has to start afresh, and has asked for photographs of the World's Fair — the original inspiration.
A red-faced Archie asks if you will have tea with him.
Archie promises to report any further progress to you.
Archie is most grateful for your help with the photographs.

Rohit Bhargava has exacted revenge on Sir Archibald for having lost his Great Eastern blueprints, making the ship even bigger than before in his new plan. Archie will certainly now be needing your support to muster the extra sheet metal.

Good news! Mr. Bhargava has finished the new plans for the Great Eastern, though somehow I knew I'd be punished for losing the originals — in the new design, the ship appears to have grown bigger still! Sadly, Crown steel reserves are rather low — but perhaps you have some to spare?
Archie has an update on the Great Eastern.
Archie complains of another hitch with the Great Eastern.

More delays to the launch of the Great Eastern. The propeller is just so massive — believe me, I've seen it at close quarters — that it has overturned an imperial tugboat! Do you think you might be able to help retrieve the propeller?
Archie has heard that his order of steel may be ready.

Architect Rohit Bhargava has demanded an oversized propeller for the Great Eastern, which may unfortunately have caused the tugboat ferrying it to sink. A thoroughly embarrassed Archie asks if you wouldn't mind retrieving the (apparently buoyant) propeller from the wreckage.
Sir Archibald Blake is now thoroughly embarrassed.
Archie is keen to know if the propeller is in one piece.

Retrieve:
[Conditions QuestCondition CurrentAmount]/[Conditions QuestCondition Amount] Massive Propeller

With the propeller fitted, things are looking rosier for the long-overdue launch of the Great Eastern — but there has been another snag. It seems that to turn such a massive propeller, equivalent oomph is needed from the engines. You may have to help poor beleaguered Archie lay his hands on some bigger pistons.
Archie thanks you for your continued support.

The propeller has been debarnacled and fitted, and I must say, it does look splendid... However, Mr. Bhargava and I have since crossed swords over a lack of power in the engine room. It seems we may have to commission some steam motors from you, if we want that propeller to spin like billy-o.

Ah yes, all those piston arms firing in perfect sync! Thank you. Now, if you cross all your toes and fingers, and don't sneeze, then the Great Eastern may finally be ready to leave the drydock. As my saviour, you shall be the first to know when it does!
Archie promises to let you know if and when the Great Eastern is built.
Archie would like to see your engines.

Thanks to all your support during its construction, the Great Eastern prototype is now ready to slop into the ocean, and Archie has decided that you should be the one to keep it. Apparently, legendary architect Rohit Bhargava is on board. It seems he would like to cut out the middleman, and work with you directly in future.
Sir Archibald Blake has a long-overdue surprise for you.
Sir Archibald gifts you a prototype of the Great Eastern

Finally, the Great Eastern is afloat! Please, do keep her — I've had quite enough of her, and frankly, Her Majesty has lost interest too. Don't be surprised to find Mr. Bhargava aboard — he has, after all, a most positive impression of you, and is rather keen to work with you again in future.

Canis lupus. Can smell you a mile away.
Vulpes vulpes. Makes dens in back gardens.
Larus argentatus. Eats human refuse.
Cervus elaphus. Majestic forest creatures.
Chelonia mydas. Swims for its life.
Rattus. They're everywhere!
Accipitridae. The definitive birds of prey.
Columba. Tuppence a bag.
Apodidae. These birds are fast.
Ciconiiformes. Nests on telegraph poles.
Felis catus. Saunters around the house.
Bos taurus. Ten thousand years our allies.
Gallus gallus domesticus. It's a chicken.
Canis familiaris. Your best friend.
Equus africanus asinus. They look a bit sad.
Capra aegagrus hircus. A stubborn sort.
Equus ferus caballus. Measured in hands.
Bos primigenius taurus. A domestic draught animal.
Sus scrofa domesticus. Poor little piggies.
Ovis aries. Its memory's a little woolly.
Cygnus. A favourite of the Queen.
Psittaciformes. Colourful and talkative birds.
Medusozoa. Wibble-wobble, wibble-wobble!
Rhopalocera. In all their fascinating cycles of life.
Vulpes zerda. Skips around the desert looking for Jerboas.
Gekkota. A collection of sticky-fingered lizards.
Hippocampoi. Horses who gallop across oceans.
Brachypelma albopilosum. A big old hairy spider.
Pterois miles. Its venomous spikes repel predators!
Manta alfredi. A beautiful and bizarre submariner.
Vultur gryphus. A majestic vulture with a vast wingspan.
Larus pacificus. A very large species of gull.
Larus californicus. A bird drawn to the insects found in cities.
Ursus arctos. A large and overbearing lover of salmon.
Ursus americanus. Smells six times better than a dog.
Axis axis. An unusual deer, known for its spottiness.
Rangifer tarandus. Has antlers, and a very shiny nose.
Ovibos moschatus. A bovine with an alluring scent.
Bison bonasus. The subject of some of our earliest cave paintings.
Vulpes cana. These foxes can climb vertical cliffs.
Pavo muticus. A bird with iridescent plumage.
Vicugna pacos. Not to be confused with llamas, who spit a lot.
Phoenicopterus roseus. Fed carrots to keep their feathers pink.
Struthionidae. A big bird with a good kick.
Crocodylinae. Little birds help clean their giant teeth.
Bubulus arnee. Understandably reluctant to co-habit with tigers...
Ursus maritimus. Could teach humans a thing or two about hunting.
Tursiops truncatus. Loves to laugh and play as much as we do.
Orcinus orca. A predator as intelligent and ruthless as humans.
Gorilla. You may find them gathered on a misty mountainside.
Pandinus imperator. A large stinger that fluoresces a very royal blue.
Alcedinidae. A keen angler, jacketed in azure and orange.
Naja ashei. Only try to handle these if you have spectacles close by!
Tetraodontidae. To attract a mate, males draw geometrical designs in the sand.
Pelicanus thagus. A huge pouch filters its prey from the water it swallows.
Calyptorhynchus lathami. Black, but with teasing sensational red underfeathers.
Pagophila eburnea. Looks like snow, and certainly doesn't mind the cold.
Cervus canadensis. Also a wapiti, though not quite as big as a moose.
Pusa hispida. The smallest and most common Northern seal. A rare find.
Otocyon megalotis. Its giant ears are used for thermoregulation.
Canis lupus arctos. Has a smaller brain, and bigger fangs than other wolves.
Xiphias gladius. A rare slashing-nose duellist of the deep.
Panthera tigris tigris. Perhaps the most beautiful of all creatures.
Puma concolor. A secretive feline, master of all New World terrains.
Panthera onca. Kills prey with no more than a powerful bite to the skull.
Melanosuchus niger. Newborns come with vibrant yellow markings.
Lophiiformes. Highly adaptable, they can rise from the abyssal depths to hunt near the coast.
Panthera onca. A melanic variation of the jaguar, who sometimes even eat crocs.
Inia geoffrensis. Pink! Unfused vertebrae allow them to turn their heads 90 degrees.
Amazona vittata. If the life mate of this parrot is injured, it will look for a new partner.
Paradisaeidae. Males attract mates with colourful displays or complex dancing rituals.
Tremarctos ornatus. This introverted bear reaches fruit by building platforms made from twigs.
Lagenorhynchus obscurus. Known for its mid-air acrobatics, this dolphin is monochromatic!
Stenella frontalis. A rare, yet boisterous dolphin, remarkable for its many white speckles.
Feresa attenuata. Oft mistaken for a killer whale, it's really rather more like a tiny dolphin.
Physeter macrocephalus. A finless whale, with the largest brain of all known animals.
Carcharodon carcharias. A great and toothy hunter, it may rest, but will never sleep.
Pseudorca crassidens. A thick-toothed grampus of a whale that likes to dive deep.
Pongo. The characteristic mating call of the male issues from its bulbous throat pouch.
Gorilla. Hark! The mighty silverback stands on two feet and bashes his chest!
Alligator sinensis. A white-pigmented lizard of the East, very protective of its eggs!
Panthera tigris tigris. What immortal hand or eye decided you needed an extra flourish of white?
Nestor productus. The rasping call of this singular orange parrot is said to resemble the bark of a dog.
Kolponomos clallamensis. Though long thought extinct, an isolated group of these bear-like hunters have somehow lived on!
Megaloceros giganteus. It's giant! Its antlers are giant! And now it's come prancing back from the past!
Vulpes zerda. A crepuscular and fleet-footed desert-dweller, with white fur and very, very long ears.
Canis dirus. Once thought extinct, this wolf's bite is more powerful than any known canine. Don't miss feeding time!
Lipotes vexillifer. The goddess of protection to fishermen along the long river, though she is hardly ever seen.
Phocoena sinus. A small porpoise of such discretion and reserve, some doubt their existence - but here's proof!
Panthera pardus adersi. Feared by farmers, these island-dwellers are thought to be servants of witches.
Pongo tapanuliensis. A rare and bashful orangutan with a disc-like face, who likes to eat caterpillars and pine kernels.
Elephas maximus. Captive elephants of this species die much earlier than their wild counterparts.
Pavo cristatus. Our groom parades his bridal train long before the wedding.
Gorilla gorilla gorilla. Due to albinism, this delightful male looks exceptional, but struggles to see very far.

Of historical value only.

Some went their whole lives without ever seeing one.
A ceremonial silver headpiece of untold beauty, but unknown provenance.

A ceremonial silver sword, which clearly only ever served a decorative purpose.

The skeleton of a king among corsairs, who shall be saluted with cannons before we sail to sea.

The man of many ways, finds many ways to get home to his disbelieving wife and son.

The stone tiles of a lost city, adorned with scarcely decipherable hieroglyphs.

Early paintings of bisons in charcoal and ochre that are so exquisite, they've been called frauds.
Walking among the reliefs of lapiths and centaurs transports one to the Aegean age.
Part of a gentle sanctuary built to honour a goddess of strategy and warfare.
Concentric patterns of ivy or vine make one feel as dizzy as a guest of the deity.
A T-shaped megalithic tomb, where it is thought purifying funeral rites were held.
Intricately interlaced stone carvings, a hallmark of Goidelic ritual and belief.
The many and varied treasures of Ben Sahid, the greatest pirate of all time.
Claims about its authenticity are suitably flimsy, but if it is what it's said to be...
A particularly large and lustrous specimen of the world's most desirable rock.

Those who stumbled upon these fossilised eggs at first mistook them for those of a giant bird.
Fits only the slender finger of the rightful heir to a forgotten kingdom.
A fearsome sword, no doubt wielded by the most dreaded old cove of coves.
These towering standing stones are the gatekeepers to a bygone era.
A fine carving of old vessels led by dragon prows, which once sailed Northern seas.

A runic fantasy of rings, battles for middle earth, and the enduring friendship between two shovel-footed homunculi.
Its plated wings are reminiscent of the mythological Nordic riders, who lived and died on the battlefield.
Homo neanderthalensis. Found embedded in mud and clay, it is a revelation as to the place of humans in nature.
A fabled collection of epic poems that gives us a window into the lives and mythology of the Nordic peoples.
An ingenious cyclical calendar system of stone, which predicts the world will end in about two-hundred years!

The harbour of an ancient port that may have traded in turquoise and jade with the distant Old World.

Perfectly preserved cave paintings depicting the many animal companions of our great ancestors.
A remarkably well-preserved monument of the Aegean Golden Age that smacks of dolphins and fish.
The last vestige of the beating heart of the Empire of the Eagle. Senators and emperors wandered these halls.
An epic depiction of East and West meeting in battle, rendered in miniature stone tiles.
Celestial energy resonates between these awesome stones, so go ahead - grab a chisel and take some home!
The sacrificial altar of an ancient Nordic temple, where nine males of every living creature were offered to the gods.
The legendary blade of a generous Goidelic ruler. It is said that, if drawn by one worthy, the blade shall blaze with fire.
Merely opening this occult tome makes those nearby uncomfortable. Apparently, the whole thing came to its author in a waking dream; such is his deep, dark and perturbing talent.
