A farmer's gift. "Foster it the way you foster us farmers, and its branches will reach up to the heavens!"
A farmer's gift. "She has a very rare pattern of spots on her hindquarters, and the most cheerful disposition you can imagine!"
A farmer's gift. "When I baked this, I thought of your proven kindness and good leadership!"
A farmer's gift. "You have to try this! Rosetta's been giving me much more, and much richer milk since we settled on this island!"
A farmer's gift. "Straight from the pot. All you have to do is peel 'em!"
A farmer's gift. "This beauty was vital for many a harvest. I hope it will serve your busyness just as well!"
A worker's gift. "I drowned all my sorrows with that. Maybe you could do the same, boss - if you know feelings like sorrow, that is..."
A worker's gift. "It's me personal collection. Helps you to fix stuff. Y'know, just in case..."
A worker's gift. "I was told this fella is able to talk, but he's not. Maybe he doesn't like my loose tongue. Why don't you give it a try, boss?"
A worker's gift. "In the mines, they said this was like gold to you, boss. I don't have any real gold, so I thought I'd offer my thanks with this instead."
A worker's gift. "I don't want to go above me station 'ere, boss, but it would be a right pleasure to raise a glass with you!"
A worker's gift. "Just in case you have to wake us up, boss. We can be bunch of sleepyheads sometimes..."
An artisan's gift. "If you ever forget time the way I do, this beauty will set you back on course - I guarantee it!"
An artisan's gift. "Take this. If even I, a lowly craftsman, suffer insomnia, goodness knows what it must be like to preside over an empire!"
An artisan's gift. "Just in case you want to make yourself heard. I sometimes get the feeling people aren't listening - at least not to me!"
An artisan's gift. "If ever you wish to get down to the nitty-gritty, as I do, this will help you out."
An artisan's gift. "This is Sourpuss, my goat. Please, take it. Just in case you feel like shouting at someone, but you don't want to shout at people like, well... us."
An artisan's gift. "I found this in the attic. I think it's a really fine example of craftsmanship. When you look at it, think of us!"
An engineer's gift. "Look at the way it's been structured. How the materials support each other. The beauty of functionality!"
An engineer's gift. "I invented the breakthrough stainless ink with this! I can't think of a better present for someone like you!"
An engineer's gift. "I wrote down everything that should be done, but which is always forgotten. Use it wisely."
An engineer's gift. "Even in its broken state, this, the very first generator I built, still means the world to me."
An engineer's gift. "It may not be working quite as intended, but there's so much potential. Study with care, and draw your own conclusions."
An engineer's gift. "I know, it doesn't look spectacular - but I thought a lot about this one, and I think it may work."
An investor's gift. "Ever since I placed this beauty in my front garden, the burglars have stayed away."
An investor's gift. "Too many subjects envy hard-working business people like us." Immediately calls the guards.
An investor's gift. "Your wise leadership is beneficial to all of us. Let's celebrate with a small bottle of bubbly!"
An investor's gift. "It took me to the top - it's a sure thing it'll do the same for you!"
An investor's gift. "Just in case you want to take a nice picture of your many material possessions."
An investor's gift. "A biologist once gave them to me as a present, after I financed his first jungle expedition."
A jornalero's gift. "It's just a donkey, jefe. But he was the brother I never had."
A jornalero's gift. "Without this fella, my brain would have been roasted by the sun. Maybe it will protect you from going crazy, too..."
A jornalero's gift. "When you have to chew on something, these are pretty good, jefe!"
A jornalero's gift. "Don't listen to what he says, jefe. He's just a parrot!"
A jornalero's gift. "Look at this beauty, jefe. Never seen a bird like this. Love her, even though she's just ranting and raving."
An obrero's gift. "I don't have any money or treasures to thank you, but this is my favourite novel. I must have read it a thousand times."
An obrero's gift. "He's such a cutie. If you're ever lonely, Jose will make you smile again."
An obrero's gift. "They may look ordinary, but after you've tasted them you'll think differently!"
An obrero's gift. "Look, this is how my grandma worked. And thanks to you, I go to a factory now and make this my own life."
An obrero's gift. "I found this beautiful stone. Think it might be precious, don't you think?"

Originating in the high peaks of the New World, these animals are well adapted to rocky cliffs and cloudy forests. The alpaca and their cousins have become loyal companions to the human inhabitants of the region, with whom they have worked as pack animals for centuries.

The forest creatures of the taiga — a cold, northern coniferous forest. Understanding the lives of animals that are able to survive the long harsh winters on very little encourages your people to show restraint in their own consumption.

Not only do these fabled creatures exist, but in your hospitality they have a chance at avoiding permanent extinction! That the tales were true will surely appeal to the romantic notions of writers in your city.
Creatures of the abyss, these are ocean killers you wouldn't want to come face to face with. Your aquaria of marine predators can educate your people about life under the sea.

Originating from the rainforest basin, the vivid colours of these animals are without equivalent in the Old World. Your city's fashionistas will no doubt take inspiration from their flamboyant markings.

An array of exotic fauna endemic to the eastern subcontinent, as encountered through the ages by merchants on the Silk Road. This display will no doubt attract similarly wealthy visitors from afar, and perhaps even their exotic gifts!
While these farm animals may seem nothing special to most visitors, there still remains a lot to learned about breeding and caring for our domestic species.
To see the variety of animals that live along the Great Coral Reef is extremely educational for young children. Amused by the dolphins, they'll better understand the complexities of life.
Depigmentation, mutation or natural adaptation — what does it matter? These powder-white ghosts are a rare and wondrous sight when by chance they descend on a heavenly cloud.

Trench-scudding monstrosities of nightmare, these freakish denizens of the deep, formerly believed to have "accidentally fallen from the surface", will provoke gasps of horror and fascination from the public, while enriching your scientists' knowledge about the fauna of the abysses.

Fireflies of the deep, these bizarre organisms bioluminesce with such variety that those unacquainted with their existence are likely to be left feeling dazzled. The discovery and understanding of their luminescence can encourage your people to better beautify their interiors.

In the inhospitable landscape of the Polar Circle, a handful of incredible creatures have evolved to adapt to unfathomably cold temperatures. Their thick coats of skin, fur and feathers keep them warm even under frozen seas and unending blizzards.
The Arctic tundra reminds your visitors of the challenging conditions those lost on Arctic expeditions have had to endure, a popular hot — or rather, very cold — topic at the moment.

The full splendour of the ancient southern empire, known for their buildings and infrastructure that were far ahead of their time. Discovering their history can better inform modern construction, and encourage your people to contribute more towards their city.
The haunting funereal remains of a mysterious New World civilisation, unearthed for the public. A go-to destination for any leading figure hoping to be enchanted.
The first steps our ancestors took through the wilderness of prehistory, on display to the public. Likely to help your citizens develop a basic understanding of resource-gathering for survival.
The golden age of piracy, and all the adventures that came with it. The romance of that fading age is likely to win the hearts of your sailors.

The distinctive religious architecture and mythological inscriptions left behind by the ancient city states of the Aegean. Your people will soon want their famous tragedies to play in your theatres and museums.
The colossal ruined cities of stone that lie hidden beneath the canopy of the New World jungle. Learning more about these civilisations may help you discover the long lost Golden City.
Ceremonial objects of the Nordic culture that once spread fear and destruction along the shores of the Old World. Their skill at war, and their famous fearlessness may inspire your own forces.
Ground-breaking geological discoveries that put into question our very origins! Serving as an open university, your museum's revelations may result in reduced attendances at church.

A protohistorical civilization from the north west of the Old World, known for its stone circles and magical forests. The inherent beauty of your quarries and forests may now finally sink in for visitors to the exhibition.

So, the stories were true! After all, what else could possibly explain these drowned memories of a forgotten time - fragments of those who lived on that great continent that once lay beyond the narrow strait. As the (highly questionable) origin of earthly civilisation, knowledge gathered from atlantean ruins may help your archaeologists determine the location of other lost cities.

Remnants of the day two vast empires clashed at the cape of Trelawney. Each sunken object a cenotaph to those who died on both sides; the servants of patriotism and duty, bound eternally with the sea. Reminders of the glory days may boost your own citizens' patriotism, even in the harshest times.
A greater insight into the Inuit and pre-Inuit cultures that inspires a sense of wonder and civic peace. An eye-opening exhibition that breaches the distance between two very different people.
From cubs to mastodons, all are powerless against the Arctic's freezing temperatures. Ice has preserved the pieces of this exhibition in a near-perfect state.
A collection of gigantic, colourful and sometimes edible plants that originated in the New World. This eclectic collection may stimulate an interest in fruit production among your people.
The calypso palms and bright corals of the westward isles. Visitors will enjoy tranquil walks in the azure seascape, hardly noticing the time pass. It may convince them to holiday for longer.
Some plants commonly found in marshes. Marsh plants can be poisonous and house mosquitoes and other creatures humans consider pests. Your people may begin to take more care in regard to hygiene.
Plants both beautiful and demure from the Near East. The wild, understated beauty of this display may provoke your people to have dreams of the exotic.
The divine and revered plants of eastern jungles. This sanctuary of sacred plants from afar may attract pilgrims who'll want to make offerings to these living deities.
The most common plants found in the icy north. Studying boreal flora may help your people better understand forest biomes.

A small collection of plants surviving in the arid mountains of the New World. The plants of the Andes have strong powers of water retention. Studying them may help your people to perfect agricultural processes.

The essential plants of medicinal gardens, as grown by monks in past times. Traditional medicinal plants have value even in a time of rapid scientific disovery. Studying them may turn up new cures and help people recover faster.

A fascinating collection of plants with darkly mysterious properties. The rediscovery of these witchy plants, and their use by humans, may rejuvenate the production of more socially acceptable vices in the city.

The Cordillera Park in your zoo inspires your farmers and jornaleros to use alpacas in their daily work.
The Taiga Forest Park in your zoo encourages your people to show moderation in their food consumption.
The Extinct Species Park in your zoo inspires creative writers in your city. They will regularly ask for your help.
The Ocean Predators Park in your zoo teaches your people a lot about the behaviour of marine life.
The Rainforest Park animals in your zoo inspire new colorful decorative patterns for your city.
The Eastern Jungle Park in your zoo attracts rich merchants from afar.
The Farm Animal Park teaches your people domestic animal care and breeding.
The Great Coral Reef Park in your zoo educates children, and increases the happiness of workers and artisans.
The Albino Park encourages many more visitors, keen to donate and preserve these pale peculiarities.
The Abyssal Depths Park delivered precious knowledge about the long-unknown deep abysses and their fauna. Your zoological searches during diving sessions now have a greater chance of success.
The Luminaries Park in your zoo inspires your people to use better lighting at their venues, resulting in astonishing phosphorescent displays for the viewing pleasure of their customers.
The animals that live in the Arctic Polar Circle are perfectly prepared to endure sub-zero temperatures. Your clothing production buildings are inspired by their naturally engineered coats.
The Arctic Tundra Park attracts plenty of curious visitors, eager to learn more about the conditions those lost in the Arctic have had to endure.
The Empire of the Eagle Exhibition in your museum inspires your people to build safer architecture and pay higher taxes.
The New World Huaca Exhibition in your museum attracts the leading figures of the esotericism world to your city.
The Origin of Mankind Exhibition in your museum reminds your people of ancestral techniques for resource gathering.
The Skull and Bones Exhibition in your museum converted your sailors to piracy.
The Aegean Culture Exhibition in your museum promoted classical literature. As such, your theatres now perform ancient tragedies, making your city more attractive.
The Lost Cities Exhibition in your museum contains clues about a legendary city of gold. Merchants will sometimes return from said legendary city, with gold.
The Northern Sagas Exhibition in your museum fills your people with a warlike spirit, which empowers your military.
The Jurassic Exhibition in your museum abandons creationism in favour of evolutionary theory, with life-sized specimens!
The Bronze Age Exhibition reminds both your people, and any visitors, of the beauty of natural landscapes like quarries and forests.

The Atlantis Exhibition has been studied by your historians; the cryptic messages and shapes of the lost civilization spawning theories about other lost cities. Your archaeological searches during diving sessions now have a greater chance of success.
The Battle of Trelawney exhibition fills your people with a deep sense of patriotism, defending their nation during naval battles whatever the cost.
Inspired by the Thule Relics Exhibition, your people become more curious and respectful of the Arctic and everything related to it.
In awe at the perfect state of conservation of the Icebound Exhibition, your food and drinks producers have learned a thing or two about preservation.
By studying the Amazon Garden, your people are now able to seed their own local plantations of fruit trees that were previously impossible to grow.
Visitors exploring your Sargasso Sea Garden now have an overwhelming thirst for vacation and island life. Some of them will stay forever.

Prosperity Contract

Crackerjack! The perfect shot. Though a slender target, the mast snaps through, burying its operators in debris and leaving the boat dead in the water. With the freedom of their ship, your crew find an ingenious-looking machine, but no sign of the Prosperity contract. Nevertheless, you are now certain it must have changed hands in nearby Montoya, and make a beeline for the port.

Woomph! Your brutes descend like gibbons on lianas. What few cultists are aboard the ship are ruthlessly dispatched. With the freedom of their ship, your crew find some arcane Pyrphorian devices, but no sign of the Prosperity contract. Nevertheless, you are now certain it must have changed hands in nearby Montoya, and make a beeline for the port.

It works this time. Firing from a closer range, your competent cannoneers have no trouble picking out the mast. It buries the enemy in debris, and leaves the sail-less boat adrift. With the freedom of their ship, your crew find some arcane Pyrphorian devices, but no sign of the Prosperity contract. Now knowing it can only have changed hands in nearby Montoya, you make a beeline for the port.

Your crew lick their lips. You thought they seemed the types to enjoy tussles at close quarters, and so it proves. Cloaks drop all around, and with the cultists dead, the ship is yours. Your crew find an ingenious-looking machine aboard, but no sign of the Prosperity contract. Now knowing it can only have changed hands in nearby Montoya, you make a beeline for port.

The cowled figures fall like beetles swept from a window ledge. Your marksmen pause to survey the scene. "A fearful desire these Pyrphorians have to die for their cause...", says one wistfully. Picking through their ship reveals some arcane Pyrphorian devices, but no sign of the Prosperity contract. Now knowing it can only have changed hands in nearby Montoya, you make a beeline for the port.

With the freedom of the ship, your crew find some arcane Pyrphorian devices, but no sign of the Prosperity contract. Now knowing it can only have changed hands in nearby Montoya, you make a beeline for the port.

FIRST FARMERS LAND

Farmers flock to join [Participants Current Profile CompanyName], hoping to prosper from the earth as they always have done. At least at first, there will be little time for naps behind the haystack as the new settlement begins to find its feet...
FIRST WORKERS CLOCK IN

First workers bustle into [Participants Current Profile CompanyName], trading in sleepy ploughs for a bright industrial future. A bold new era begins as the furnaces are lit, plumes of smoke issue from chimney stacks, and workers don the grim and gritty garb of the factories.
FIRST ARTISANS DRIFT IN

New Artisan arrivals add culture and sophistication to [Participants Current Profile CompanyName], exhibiting much-needed flair and flourish. Gauzy fabrics and perfume enswathe this troupe of motley individualists. See the special pull-out within entitled "Herding Cats."
FIRST ENGINEERS ENGAGED

First Engineers bring discovery to the city! Books, telescopes and chemicals under their arms, they arrive in uniformed rows, peering over spectacles at their new habitat. Their welcome rationality is sure to trigger a sharp upturn in efficiency and advancement.
FIRST INVESTORS BREEZE IN

First Investors arrive! Umbrellas tap on the pavement and capacious top hats devour hatstands – the elite are finally here! The markets are expected to see major growth in the coming weeks, with share prices already soaring. For a list of potential investments, see finance pp. 14-17.
NEW COMPANY TAKES ROOT!

[Participants Current Profile CompanyName] settles first island! Hopes abound that this seed will germinate into a great leafy tree, boughs heavy with golden fruit! In historic edition, we profile company pioneer, and enjoy the positivity – who knows if we shall see its like again!
COMPANY SETTLES IN TROPICS

[Participants Current Profile CompanyName] settles first island in the new world. Sticky financial climate at first, but refreshing cloudbursts forecast! Previously uninhabited island to act as initial HQ for overseas business in waters hitherto uncharted!
DARING EXPANSION!

[Participants Current Profile CompanyName] incorporates new territory in bold move! Hopes for splendid new settlement arise! Uninhabited island meets with humankind for the first time, as company brings this secluded idyll into the fold.
COMPETITOR SETTLES ISLAND

One of our competitors has settled a new island in the region, according to reports. It is hard to determine whether this will spur on our own enterprise, but at the least it serves as a reminder of the challenge for resources our people face.
ISLAND OF OPPORTUNITY?

Previously uncharted island found! The uninhabited spot is full of promise, say surveyors, who were among the first to wade up the beach this morning alongside excited cartographers, botanists and investors keen to sniff the place out.
FRIEND OR FOE?

New competitors appearing from beyond our borders have us brimming with anticipation. Will they be naughty, will they be nice? Will they bring us fish tails, bird eggs or mice? Our foreign correspondent digs up more juicy morsels concerning our new neighbours pp.17-18.
NEW TERRITORY DISCOVERED!

[Participants Current Profile CompanyName] has discovered a new region overseas, and is already going about the business of gathering the necessary resources to establish an outpost there. For those wishing to see the world, there has never been such a time as now - apply at once within!
NEW HAVEN!

[Participants Current Profile CompanyName] has discovered a new clutch of islands overseas; rumour has it they're considering investing substantial time and resources there. Keen to seek your fortune in faraway places? Speculative applications welcome!
NEW ARCHIPELAGO!

[Participants Current Profile CompanyName] has discovered a new clutch of islands overseas; rumour has it they're considering investing substantial time and resources there. Keen to seek your fortune in faraway places? Speculative applications welcome!
ANOTHER LEVEL!

[Participants Current Profile CompanyName] is soaring high, as recently published estimations rank our people more advanced than ever before. "I have faith our governor will sustain this exponential growth," declares monocle-wielder, "we leap like young salmon!"
RIVAL COMPANY STEPS UP
With recent key advance for our rival, we cast our eyes over the strengths and weaknesses of their company, asking whether they might pose a threat to us. Full and frank analysis, pages 3-5.
LEFT IN THE DUST!

Our rival is striding away! While we, like a spotty bottom, are eclipsed! Let us dwell on our inferiority, carefully inspect our failings, and wonder how we might possibly catch them back up before the great race is over!
TRADE VESSEL LEAVES DRY DOCK!

Worthy trade boat leaves [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName] ready for maiden voyage! Capacious hold asking to be filled to brim with riches, which naturally will be shared among loyal populace!
WARSHIP LEAVES DRY DOCK!
Proud new warship [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName] on first patrol! Brave crew wished luck by loved ones, and revelling in the romance of not knowing if they'll ever come back!
VAST FLEET CONSTRUCTED!
[Participants Current Profile CompanyName] spawns armada! For what purpose, we can only hazard a guess, but whether for naval victory or merchant profit, a larger fleet must always be better!
SHIP PRODUCTION SLOWS
A lack of manpower is holding back our shipbuilding! There are plenty of jobs to be done down at the dock, but no-one seems suitable or interested enough to take up these positions.
TRADE FLEET ASSEMBLED!

[Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName] spawns merchant navy! Trade will surely flourish, now this bright and colourful selection have been dispatched with their ample tonnages, perhaps to meet with new and exotic trade partners!
NAVAL ARMADA ASSEMBLED!

[Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName] spawns awe-inspiring naval armada! Of what noble victories and conquests may we now dream?! Let us rejoice, and blissfully ignore any possibility they may be used to serve unjust causes!
A REAL STEAMER!

First ever steam vessel christened for [Participants Current Profile CompanyName]! Never more shall bad winds addle our business, or put our navy off their stride! No! Steamed, stoked and screw-propellered ships shall surge us ever more into contention!
THE PROMISED LAND!

Settlers arrive in numbers to [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName], its illustrious doors opening to reveal a shimmering utopia! Of course, if they lived here, they'd know not to expect that, but still, growth is good!
MURDEROUS EXODUS!

For masses desperately fleeing dastardly [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName], life couldn't possibly be worse! That people would pack their worldly possessions and run only goes to show what dire straits the town finds itself in.
EARTHLY PARADISE!

We are as joyful as we can possibly be!' the hysterical people squeal, as they dance in the euphoric streets of [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName]! If there is indeed a secret recipe for happiness, our fair city must contain all of the necessary ingredients!
HAPPINESS AND LIGHT

[Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName] is quite full of mirth! "Eight and three-fifths from ten is how I score my present feeling," one resident remarked during recent census, "yet I am not completely delirious..."
PEOPLE JUST ABOUT CONTENT

[Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName] is a dull, occasionally satisfactory place to live, according to residents. Why is this town so run-of-the-mill, when it could be so very much more? We detail in full pp. 3-7 exactly what makes life here so bland...
UNHAPPY HOME!

Local hearts filled with woe in [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName]! Streets wet with tears, as residents weep for the neglect! "I still want to believe in this place," says one we met, "But the dream is dying!"
PEOPLE ARE FURIOUS!

Anger at living conditions in [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName]! Residents on verge of drastic action to end hardship! Our newspaper maintains responsibility to report the grievous situation of the people, though our livelihoods may suffer for it!
GENERAL MOOD IMPROVES!

Happier days return to [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName]! Either people have learned to cope better, or indeed as this paper believes, living conditions have demonstrably improved in recent times. More grounds for domestic optimism pp. 5 and 6.

New artillery fortifies [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName], as Big Bertha fires a salvo to trumpet her own arrival. Sea birds scatter, and rattles clatter. The city has finally grown a spiny husk to protect its silky horse chestnuts.

RISKING IT ALL FOR A PHOTOGRAPH

Balloonist Mr F. Tourniquet courts disaster as he attempts to snap the city as seen by "wild geese". Photographic chemicals and balloon captaincy threaten to collide in mid-air as Tourniquet leans out for the perfect shot of [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName].

GOING UP!

Goode Tidings
TRAITOR DIES MYSTERIOUSLY IN PRISON
Reports Samuel Goode couldn't face humiliation of a trial. Miserable few at funeral still more than 'Judas ever deserved'.
EDVARD THE SAVIOUR
Mr. Edvard Goode speaks of 'bold new era' for Goode and Sons, nobly bearing the burden 'terrible traitor' brother dropped at his door.
ISLAND SALE CALAMITY!
Empire rocked by sale of strategic island "Prosperity". Young Queen facing first major crisis thanks to Samuel Goode's act of treason.
Approved by Edvard Goode
Bright Sands, Thurs, 8th January, Anno 1800.
PHOENIX FROM THE ASHES
Goode’s heirs create breakaway shipping company in the image of their father, who they say was a man of principle. After all, there is no surefire evidence he did anything wrong at all!
EXPLOSIVE DEVELOPMENT!
Big blast in the mountains secures vital iron lode for ambitious Goode siblings, venturing into warship manufacture for the monarch herself!
SAMUEL GOODE'S MURDERER EXPOSED
Goode siblings track down their father's murderer, a man unlikely to have acted alone. Indeed, rumours circulate of links to a peculiar sect.
A LEAP INTO THE NEW WORLD
Goode siblings venture into unknown territories, and locate Isabel Sarmento! Will the anti-imperial leader of rebels co-operate? Is she key to the truth about Samuel and the island of Prosperity?
THE PYRPHORIAN EVIL!

Heretical cult of the goddess Pyr takes hold in the New World! Sarmento's movement cruelly subjugated and oppressed. Do they crave only to exhaust the wellsprings of oil on Prosperity, or do they have yet more sinister plans!?
PROSPERITY AWARDED TO GOODE SIBLINGS!

War between Queen and rebel Sarmento over Prosperity prevented! Goode siblings find proof of Samuel's innocence in indisputable guilt of their Uncle! Scoundrel Edvard found to have sold Prosperity to Isabel unlawfully!
ROYAL COURT OF JUSTICE BUILT!

Trial of Edvard set to begin, as Queen arrives at new court built by Goode siblings. Ample ceremony and security provided for all involved, including Isabel Sarmento, witness to the unlawful sale of Prosperity, who has bravely come forward.
THE END OF ALL EMPIRE?

Traitor Edvard Goode dead! Bright Sands aflame! Hooded figures descend upon the innocent, in a bid to assassinate Her Majesty and establish a new order in the world! An order that believes in the most terrifying chaos!
QUEEN RETURNS BRIGHT SANDS TO HEIRS!
Goode siblings save world from cult of Pyrphorianism! Queen bestows rare honourary knighthoods! Goode and Sons is unified and prosperous again under adroit leadership of its heirs!
ARE YOU A GENIUS?
Only people with a high opinion of themselves can answer these extremely impossible questions...
YOU MUST READ THIS!
Man rides half-broken boneshaker over massive cobbles. What happens next will combust your mind!
TEN SURPRISINGLY DELICIOUS CREATURES
Juicy praying mantis knocked off top by bug you won't believe! Number nine is a killer!
IS YOUR HUSBAND ADULTEROUS?
He is if he keeps these five things in his garden shed... and five ways they can help restore the former fidelity of your marriage.
ARSENIC KILLER CAUGHT!
Everybody's talking about the most distracting story in years. What she did next will leave you doubled-up...
YOU ARE HAPPIER THAN YOU THINK
Swing a pendulum before your eyes, repeating "I am happy." You will immediately feel a positive change within - or you should keep repeating it until you do.
BE GLAD YOU STILL LIVE!
Just remember, living itself is a positive outcome! Typhus, typhoid, influenza, cholera, smallpox, yellow fever, malaria, scurvy - the list of potential ways to die is endless.
THE GRASS IS NEVER GREENER!
You are lucky! Depravity and peculiarity lie beyond your borders! Unspeakable conditions, indescribable unpleasantnesses! Blissful ignorance is your cheeriest friend!
BRIGANDS AND LOOTERS!
Is that who you would associate with? You are better than that! The so-called radicals are nothing more than thieves and opportunitists looking for an excuse for pillage!
IS YOUR CONSCIENCE STAINLESS?!
Only the weak-minded give in to populism! Stay in your homes, keep yourselves to yourselves, or you may soon face a run-in with the indomitable men in blue!
YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED!
There's no hiding in numbers! In the case of revolt, anyone and everyone on the list shall be subject to the maximum penalty of Her Majesty's law!
ESCHEW ENVY!
Stop consuming! Set aside your acquisitiveness, your materialism, and learn to nourish your spirit!
IS THIS GLUTTON YOU?!
Repent your greed! St. Peter's pearly gates are not as wide as you imagine!
PURGE YOUR DEMONS!
Look at this picture - this is you! Get thee now to church, and discover your inner puritan!
SPEND, SPEND, SPEND!
Buying things makes us happy, so BUY NOW and avoid disappointing your spouse later! Who knows - you may have an accident tomorrow, so spend as if it's your last day on earth!
INVEST NOW!

Do it! Everything suggests now is the time to invest. Whether you contribute to our flawless services, or are a key part of our comprehensive border security, a flash of your cash can prove to your friends and family you aren't the penny-pincher they always thought you were.
YOUR FAMILY IS IN DANGER!

Pay your dues, and save your loved ones from a terrible fate! Your money is all that stands between the wolf-like shadow of our rivals over the border, and the children and kittens nestling so peacefully at your hearth!
WAKE UP, AND JOIN UP!
Stop dreaming! Join our elite military today, and become the hero you've always wanted to be! Experience adventure and companionship, vanquish our enemies, and be immortalised in stone!
ARE YOU A COWARD!?

Then you must surely feel the guilt! As our soldiers lead us to triumph and glory, you slouch on the couch in your undergarments! Now is the time to stand up and be counted alongside your fellow men, and keep this proud nation sovereign!
THEY'RE COMING FOR YOUR CHILDREN!
The enemy are coming to devour our little cherubs whole! Will you stand by and watch, or will you immediately enlist the moment you've read this, and put pay to the devil outside once and for all!
OUR HOPES REST ON YOU!
Double your efforts in production, and you shall have played your part! We cannot all be fighters! Stay your conscience. After all, what would they fight with if not for you!?
FINISH THE JOB!
Only through the united action of our war industries can we crush our villainous adversaries! The sooner you turn out guns, ships and ammunition, the sooner the war will be won, and you can unwind!
ENJOY YOUR SHORE LEAVE...
...our sailors don't have any - and more than ever, they want arms and support! Speed up production and repairs, and bring our brave forces home victorious!
STAY VIGILANT!
Prevent crime, fire, and disease from rearing their ugly heads! Join the citizen's watch today and end these threats to civilised living!
TAKE RESPONSIBILITY!
Volunteer NOW! Don't let everyone else take all the glory! Dress up in your favourite uniform and join in the fun!
BE A HERO!
Or watch in horror as spiralling infernos, disfiguring diseases and merciless criminals come for your children! If YOU don't save them, who do you think will?!
WE ARE THE BRAVE!
We shall fight them unbroken! We shall never surrender! Our resolve is indefatigable!
THEY ENEMY ARE ALL BUT BEATEN!
So don't relent now! The enemy are exhausted by our unity, fatigued by our endurance! Their siege is almost over, and none of us show any sign of surrender!
REPEL THE CANNIBALS!
We must fight to the very end, or be roasted alive and eaten! Every indication is that the enemy consume the flesh of their victims! So fight them to the death - or prepare for a worse fate!
YOUR WAR!
Glory awaits you, brave young soldier! Your lust for adventure, your proud family behind you, and your enemy who want sticking on your bayonet.
TAKE BACK WHAT IS YOURS!
Your cause is just, your blade is true, and your spirit as keen as the fabled Marie D'Artois!
WE HOLD ALL THE CARDS
If our enemies try to run once our suite of aces is revealed, it'll be time to go "all-in".
BEHOLD OUR SEA POWER!
Our rivals have everything to fear, for we are Poseidon, God of the Sea, brandishing our mighty trident!
ABSOLUTELY UNIFORM SLAUGHTER!
Burnished boots and shining steel, our immaculate soldiers will slice through our dim-witted enemies like putty!
SENT BACK TO THE DEEP!
We have our rivals by the tentacles! Their grubby suckers shall threaten our prosperity no more!
A FOREGONE CONCLUSION!
We have the sharper wits, even if they did - and they don't - have the sharper sticks.
PLOUGHED-DOWN FARMERS!
Abject misery of farming community - "bedrock" of [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName] - could trigger social collapse say worried economists.
A FARMING IDYLL!
Local farmers express extraordinary happiness, with ceilidh dancing amid uproarious celebration of the bucolic in [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName].
WORKER WOE!
"Life's a bloomin' misery" say [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName] workers, amid fears their extreme unhappiness will grind society to a halt.
WORKER WONDERLAND
Workers blissfully happy in the hustle and bustle of [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName], where all believe life has a greater purpose.
ALAS THE ARTISANS!
Poor artisans awfully unhappy thanks to artless governor, meaning dreadfully dreary poetry inflicted upon rest of us.
ADORING ARTISANS!
Artisan ecstasy in [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName], as romantic dream blooms streets into garden of enraptured petals.
BON VOYAGE!
As fabulous first ship departs [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName] dock, joyous sailors dust off squeezeboxes for jolly jigs.
POPULATION STABLE
[Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName] numbers remain the same, 'Things are as they've always been,' declares unconcerned resident.
CORNUCOPIA OF SAUSAGE
Sausage cascades from the heavens upon the people of [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName], who are dumbfounded by their astonishing Good fortune.
STUFFED TO THE GILLS!
Fish cascade from the heavens upon the people of [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName], who are dumbfounded by their astonishing Good fortune.
CORNUCOPIA OF SCHNAPPS!
Schnapps cascades from the heavens upon the people of [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName], who are dumbfounded by their astonishing Good fortune.
CORNUCOPIA OF BUBBLES!
Soap cascades from the heavens upon the people of [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName], who are dumbfounded by their astonishing Good fortune.
CORNUCOPIA OF CLOTH!
Work clothes cascade from the heavens upon the people of [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName], who are dumbfounded by their astonishing Good fortune.
CORNUCOPIA OF BREAD!
Bread cascades from the heavens upon the people of [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName], who are dumbfounded by their astonishing Good fortune.
CORNUCOPIA OF BEER!
Beer cascades from the heavens upon the people of [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName], who are dumbfounded by their astonishing Good fortune.
CORNUCOPIA OF CANNED FOOD!
Cans cascade from the heavens upon the people of [Newspaper FindArticle([RefGuid]) Context TownName], who are dumbfounded by their astonishing Good fortune.
YOU ARE FAMOUS!
Angel Florence Nightjar only wishes that all could be as humble and gracious as the people of [Game Profile Info Name], people like you.
CONGRATULATIONS YOU HAVE WON!
As a citizen of [Game Profile Info Name], you have qualified for the final gyration of the tombola! To claim your prize, enclose fee for your entry ticket below...
DIM ENOUGH TO OPEN THIS BOX?
Only an ignoramus forgets what befell poor Pandora! Inform the authorities of anyone who would believe anything else.
REPORT THEM!
Isolate, name and shame them. These upstart delinquents are nothing alone and broken, away from their flock.
BANISH THIS BARBARITY!
Civilisation always outlasts these misguided, violent spasms. Report radicals, and guarantee you last along with it!
YOU ARE BEING JUDGED
Do you enjoy depravity, sin, filth? The word trousers? Then there is a place for you - it's called hell!
STOP THIS CONSUMPTION!
Disease is everywhere. Everything we touch spreads illness, therefore touch as few commodities as possible!
ARE YOU RATIONAL?
Rationing is for our greater good, and without a greater good, what good are you?
LET'S EAT THE TOWN
Join Dennis Brammen in his culinary adventures as he discovers local delicacies. You'll never believe the fourth one!
THE JORGENSEN COLLECTION

Bente Jorgensen, the dauntless philanthropist, has opened the doors to her museum once again with a new exhibition. This time, the dazzling artefacts will be accompanied by professional photographs. A must-see for every culture enthusiast.
GRAVE NEWS!
Reports of arson, as strange headline-grabbing fire breaks out in the harbour!
FLAUNTER'S HAUNT
In an act of shameless self-publicity, Artur Gasparov sends an image of his city to anyone with a letterbox.
GREAT BIG SHOW OFF
In yet another act of shameless self-publicity, Artur Gasparov sends an image of his monument to his entire address book.
GASP!!! —AROV
Preening premier Artur Gasparov bears all for the sake of style, in a case of the Emperor's New Clothes.
SMILE FOR THE CAMERA
Smug-looking workers under George Smith gathered today only to express their sublime happiness. How nauseating!
MOVEMENT WANTS VOLUNTEERS
Isabel Sarmento turns to broadsheets to spread her progressive ideas, and to recruit anyone who swings faintly to the left.
COME SAIL WITH ME!
Jean La Fortune shows he and his people will be a force to be reckoned with should the Empire come knocking, and that there is a warm rum-doused welcome awating anyone who might fight beside him.
INEXPLICABLE POISONING

A Royal Council gathering at High Clarence Hall ended tragically after a mass-poisoning broke out from a still unidentified source. Investigations are being undertaken, although immediate forensic findings do not report any traceable elements that may lead to identifying the cause.
PLAYFUL GUIDES

Lead us
To uncertain fates
WHISPERS OF YORE

Fill homesick clouds
With spirits
EYES AS OLD AS TIME

Watch me from above
Patiently
BLOODTHIRSTY SARMENTO

Self-proclaimed champion of the peace, Isabel Sarmento, engages in violent frenzies the second the eyes of public opinion turn away. The photograph proves she is not as low as, but WORSE than the enemies she so hypocritically criticises for the sensible use of military tactics.
A HUMBLE WEDDING
The happy couple spoke few words, so humbled were they by the generosity of all who attended their quaint wedding at the local church.
PUNCH CLUB
I thought we weren't supposed to talk about this...
MEMBERS CLUB SHAMED!
Lower-rung knave dances in the buff like some demonic pixie outside renowned gentleman's club, bringing the whole place into disrepute!
For many, the New World represents a shining vision of hope far beyond the tumbledown rooftops and belching chimney stacks of home.
DREAMS OF FARAWAY PLACES
NEW SCHOOL YEAR BEGINS
Children everywhere are dancing merrily, flowers in their hair, until they hear the news that the misery of school is about to resume.
FAMILY TICKETS ON SALE AT ZOO
"Even a lower-middle-class family can sneak into the zoo now that they've been deemed just about worthy of a ticket," sneers local investor.
NOT SO GRAND OPENING
Few attend opening ceremony of family-run canning business, since only they and their relatives seem to have any degree of enthusiasm for it.
MAN DUCKS DUEL
Absolute coward ducks out of a duel for love of his life - he obviously didn't love enough to die for her...
ANOTHER YEAR GRADUATES...
...just like all the others. When will this non-news be moved from the front pages to the back where it belongs?
WOMAN INVENTS SOMETHING!!!
"It may seem conceited to ask to have your photograph taken beside one's own invention," says female steam engine inventor, "but you'd never have done it otherwise."
RAGS TO RICHES STORY
As annoying as he may be in almost every regard, local investor proves that in this era, you no longer have to have money in order to make money.
CHRISTMAS MIRACLE
Local tightwad has sudden change of heart overnight, deciding to shower pauper employees with baubles and presents in a selfless outpouring of long contained affection.
A YEAR OF REVOLUTION
Today marks the first anniversary of the Freedom Fighter's revolution against La Corona. These brave men and women set a powerful example for us all.
BRIGHTER SHORES
Progress and independence — two key words that define our exemplary town. Our doors are open to anyone and everyone who believes in a better, more just future.
WOMEN PROFESSIONALS

Not winds, but gales of change are brought about by a new wave of revolutionary women who are not afraid, nor ashamed to leave their households behind in search of honest professional opportunities of their own.
HONEST AND HARD-WORKING
Though they grumbled at having to sit so long to have their picture taken, this hard-working jornalero family seemed secretly rather proud to be featured on our front pages!
As unsightly a blot on the landscape as you are ever likely to see.
A stirring-the-sneeze-in-a-handkerchief kind of place.
A town as cacky as a well-used dog path.
A bleak panorama drained of all optimism and colour.
If only anyone with any damned taste worked for the local council...
Ordinary, as in, a bachelor with a 'fine personality'.
A place at least one person doesn't absolutely hate.
Nice enough while still remaining deeply weird.
Peculiarity can be attractive.
Pleasant? Now we're getting somewhere.
As well-groomed and presented as a prize cow.
Scenery that beckons like a siren's song.
Something about this place stirs people up. Don't ask me what that means.
As pretty as a postcard and redolent of all the fond memories you'd expect to follow.
Pretty, like bright balloons, riverbanks and calligraphy.
So wonderful, it has cheeky scamps skipping down the streets with dripping ices.
A very serious and grave kind of attractiveness that touches the soul.
The kind of place you might expect dresses of the highest feasible circumference.
A flawless, ineffable beauty. Like moondust settled upon ice shards.
Sumptuous in its sprawl, elegant in its limbs, this city is one of glossy celebrity.
Notoriously, deliriously beautiful in the most ambitious conceivable way.
As magical as Cinderella's evening at eleven fifty-nine.

Thank you!

What you cradle in your hands is the culmination of years of work by our team, delivering an Anno game both we and our fans can be proud of. It is also much more than that! Not only is Anno 1800 the seventh installment in the series, but it also marks the series' 20th anniversary.

20 years is a significant milestone to reach by any measure, but an especially notable one in an industry as dynamic and fast-paced as digital entertainment.

No-one could have predicted this journey back in March 1998, when an unassuming new challenger named “Anno 1602” entered the field, daring to take on the more established strategy competitors of its day.

And what a journey it's been!

Over the last 20 years, we've made our own history together. We've seen the renaissance, and the age of enlightenment. We've even travelled into the future, settled the ocean floor, and colonized the moon.

None of this would have been possible without you - the dedicated and passionate Anno fans who have inspired and empowered us every step along the way.
Our community of “Annoholics” has been our driving force, and these 20 years are a testament to your enthusiasm.

So no matter if this is your very first Anno (and if so, welcome aboard!), or if you've been with us for two decades - THANK YOU, from the bottom of our hearts!
The Anno 1800 Development Team

You can send ships on expeditions to discover animals and artifacts for your zoo and museum, rescue specialists to have them work in your city or capture pirates treasures.
The fate of the expedition will be down to you. To succeed in an expedition, you should prepare correctly:
- Rations are crucial aboard of your ship. They give moral to your crew and allow you to feed them between each obstacle their encounter. A starving crew loses more moral between each obstacle than a crew you feed. Moreover, you crew appreciates having different types of food. Feeding them with diverse rations will allow them to keep a higher moral than if you fed them with the same type of good over and over.
- The threats indicates which kind of obstacles you are most likely to encounter. Each type of obstacle can be dealt with a specific attribute (ex: Naval Power is very helpful in the case of a Naval Battle threat). When preparing for a specific threat your captain warned you against, you are increasing the moral of your crew greatly.
- To prepare for a threat, you must store in your ship a good or an item which possesses the related attribute. Ex: If the captain warns you about a wildlife threat, you should prepare to hunt. Hunting attribute can be found in goods such as fur coats or in specialist such as the Forester. In order to get the full number of the attribute indicated in the good, you need to store in the ship 50 units of that good.
- Once facing an obstacle, you will have to take decision. Most of the times, decisions are linked to attributes. The better you are in the related attribute, the most chance you have to get the best outcome of this decision.
- Expeditions have 3 different difficulties levels: Easy, Average and Hard, represented by skulls. An easy expedition will have less obstacles before you reach the reward, however the reward will be less rare than harder expedition. Moreover, it is easier to fill the moral bar of easy expedition. The hardest the expedition, the better items and goods you must store onboard in order to fill the moral bar. Hard expeditions are risky but finishing them is a certain way of getting legendary items.

Bente is the young heir to the Jorgensen Trust, a philanthropic venture of her late father's. She is an alarmingly friendly individual, caring for all around her.
An intrepid traveller, she believes the world exists for all to delight in and explore! Naturally, she is friends with almost everyone...

Princess Qing is a young and uncertain envoy of the Imperial East.
Struggling to bring about the very different diplomatic wishes of the Emperor and Empress here in a new and unfamiliar place, she takes consolation in writing wistful poetry on the nature of home.

Behind the bold swish of Willie's conjuror's cape lives a fragile mouse, desperate for the affection conferred upon him by his late mother.
Above all, it is fear that grips him — of some unspeakable and ghoulish reprisal — for Willie seems to have acquired his great fortune suspiciously suddenly!

George Smith was, long ago, a slave.
An explosion in the mine took his father, and rendered George deaf. Finding freedom, George seized the chance to make something of his life, and has now apparently done it all. But don't let that fool you — he's not finished yet.

Beryl O'Mara was a goodly soul once — back when she believed her meek shopkeeper husband would escape the debtor's prison. He didn't.
Years later, it is now her that's running the street game, with the help of her many eyes and ears. She'll invite you in for tea, but don't get too cosy — that's a sawn-off under the floral tablecloth!

Artur Gasparov is a self-proclaimed visionary, francophile, and pursuer of architectural perfection.
Breaking from the mirror only to schmooze with the most important critics, Gasparov has little patience for others, or indeed, any empathy at all. As he himself has said, 'Every great city is ruined by its people.'

Carl is a repugnant, industrialist fat-cat.
Blaming his parents for allowing the once-great name of Von Malching to fade from view, he is ever desperate to rub up with the nobility — and of course, to pile up the gold. His philosophy is "money equals reputation", so take, take and take some more!

Alonso Graves is a man disturbed. A former soldier of the Empire, war transformed his soul forever.
The disdain and misanthropy within him can only momentarily be silenced by the blood of his former masters. Believing himself now to be a god, he is intent on 'freeing' all he can from the shackles of human existence.

Admiral Vicente Silva is an experienced, calculating and humourless conqueror. His noble upbringing, and education at the finest military academies has primed him for a life in power.
A staunch traditionalist, his conviction is that the crumbling empire of La Corona - in whose service he profits - will prevail against a world in rebellion.

Lady Margaret Hunt's influence cannot be overestimated. A member of the Royal Council, she is trusted by all, rarely seeking sympathy for what has unquestionably been a difficult life.
After all, she was born a Harlow — a name now synonymous with treason — but then, that was all buried long ago.

Anne Harlow is the vengeful leader of a forsaken band — the last hurrah of piracy. She was born into nobility, only to see her father Benjamin hanged for speaking against the King.
In exile, Anne's lust to destroy the crown and social order has only grown with the arrival of a new and vulnerable queen.

Jean La Fortune escaped a life of slavery to become the leader of a fledgling nation on the isle his people call High Mountain.
But his people cannot hope to grow while the Empire refuses to recognise their independence. With few allies in society, it seems Jean has little choice left but to fight.

Isabel Sarmento is the passionate leader of a rebellion in the New World which people call "The Movement", striving for independence from Old World empires.
She lost her brother to the violence, but this only seems to have strengthened her resolve. She knows her people will have to fight clever if they want to build a lasting future for themselves.

Eli Bleakworth is a deeply resentful servant of the crown, charged with governing Wormways Prison, a depraved and isolated facility.
Taking great pleasure in carrying out punishments, he is strict and unbending, believing the scum receive only what they deserve. Suspicious to the core, he will no doubt be keeping his beady eyes on you too!

To even browse Kahina's emporium can feel like a privilege, so luxurious are her exotic displays.
But to Kahina, this whole enterprise is rather humdrum - a compromise for her comfort and safety, and one that seems desperately dull in comparison to the daredevil life of intrigue and prestige that she once led.

Sir Archibald Blake is the steadfast counsel of Her Majesty the Queen. Optimistic, tactful and yet frequently awkward, good old Archie just wants everyone to get along.
Years of diplomatic dinners have cultivated in him a great predilection for small talk, which can lead the unwary into believing he is not as wise as he truly is.

Nathaniel Spoondrift, A.K.A. "Old Nate", is a drifter, opportunist and inventor. His life's work is his zeppelin, and the island at which it is moored — both hodgepodges of parts he's spent years scrounging for.
Aside from his mysterious employees, Nate rarely crosses paths with others — not unless they're willing to help him strip a corpse.

Vasco Oliveira is the emissary of King João of La Corona, outranking and outdressing his cousin Admiral Vicente Silva. Yet he often cuts a jaded figure — a man loyal to an empire upon which the sun is setting. Whatever happens, he is sure to maintain his discretion and dignity until the very end.

Qumaq is an Inuit elder who, given his aptitude for languages, is the perfect person to welcome visitors to the Arctic. Although his previous encounters with the peoples of the Old World might reasonably have left him with a poor opinion of you, it is not in his nature to judge. Treat the Arctic with the awe and respect it deserves, and you can expect a very warm welcome at his iglu.

Lady Jane Faithful is convinced that her husband, Sir John, can still be found. His expedition went missing in the Arctic while seeking “The Passage” — a fabled shortcut to the far side of the world. The Arctic Council have long since given up hope of finding survivors, but Lady Jane plans to hold a full and final search of her own.

Residences don't need to be located close to factories. Your workforce is available wherever your factories are on an island.
You can build multiple residences, farm fields or ornaments by clicking and dragging.
Request to purchase any product from your Trading Post menu, and visiting trade ships will conduct the transaction automatically.
Check what trades have been carried out recently in the storage tab of the statistics screen.
Hold shift while building farm fields to override the farm's module limit.

Use the upgrade tool to upgrade multiple buildings at the same time. Drag to cover your selection, or hold Shift to select adjacent buildings. Holding Alt at the same time lets you downgrade multiple buildings at once.
You can also use the upgrade tool to repair multiple ruins at the same time. Simply drag to cover your selection, or hold Shift to select adjacent ruins.
You can use the upgrade tool to finalise multiple blueprints at the same time. Simply drag to cover your selection, or hold Shift to select any adjacent blueprints.
Hold Shift while upgrading to upgrade as many buildings of the same type as you can afford.
Click the middle button on your mouse to rotate any building in the building preview. It even applies to roads!
You don't need to fulfill your residents' luxury needs in order to upgrade their residences.
Fulfilling some of your residents' needs will greatly increase your income, while fulfilling others will increase their happiness.
Hold Shift while using the demolish tool to demolish different types of buildings at the same time.
Right click at any time to exit the building preview.
Lumberjack's Huts don't need to wait for a forest to grow if they're already built in a lush forest.
Load your expedition ships with different types of rations to maintain a good level of morale among your crew.
Check the captain's recommendations before launching an expedition. Prepare your ship as best you can to face every possible threat.
You can change the working conditions of your workforce on farms or in factories to increase their productivity, or decrease it to make their lives a bit easier.
Visitors can't arrive on your island via your Trading Post! You'll need to build a public mooring for them.
Be careful not to upgrade every residence! You'll still need the previous level of workforce for your production buildings! Use the downgrade button on the residence menu to correct any mistakes.
Did you know? Investor residences add influence!
You always get back the influence you invest, even on expert difficulty level.
Check the captain's recommendations before starting an expedition. Try to prepare your ship with the most appropriate supplies, equipment and personnel.
Change the working conditions at your farms or factories to get more productivity out of your workforce.
Build a public mooring to attract visitors to your island.
The right-click menu stays open if you make use of the lock symbol.
Did you know? When you hold shift and click the pause/play button on a factory, it will pause or start all factories of that type.

Did you know you can prohibit the consumption of specific goods from your marketplace, either for particular resident tiers, or for everyone? Don't forget to allow consumption again when you're ready!
Did you know you can copy streets? You can use this function to copy entire building blocks, streets included!
Did you know you can customise your right-click menu for each region by dragging and dropping tools or buildings into its slots?
Did you know that you can get a good overview of all your ships from the Statistics menu? You can find a full list of your trade and war ships under "All Islands", "Finance", "Expenses".

Did you know that you can get a good overview of the items you have equipped in each of your islands from the Statistics menu? For each island, you will find it under "Finance", "Expenses", "Administration".

In the “Items” tab of the statistics menu, you can search for both items you already own, and items you have yet to acquire. You can use the filter to search for items too: try entering the name of a resource or a building you want to affect, for example. You can also search by the name of the item, or the specific effect you're looking for.

Did you know you can customise the notifications you receive? Click on "Filter Notifications" in the notification archive and deselect the types of notifications you don't want to see anymore. You can turn them back on at any time.

If your trains are suffering from continuous delays causing oil outages, you may want to try building parallel tracks to decongest railway traffic. Split the tracks near the entrance of the Oil Harbour for better results.

One railway line is enough to ensure smooth distribution to up to 3 power plants. If you want to supply more buildings that consume oil, you should build additional sets of railway tracks running in parallel to ensure that there will always be a free line for your trains to run on.
Select a building and press the Toggle Through Buildings shortcut to jump to the next identical building.
Press the Ruins shortcut to jump to any ruin on your current island, if there are any.
Every island's overhead Goods Display can be customised to show the goods you wish to track. Simply drag and drop the desired goods from your trading post or warehouse onto the resource bar.
In the event tracker, above notifications and warnings, you can set up how you want to be informed of certain events, like exhibitions and special visitors.
You can manually transfer goods or items from a ship to your island storage if the ship is in range of the Trading Post. Simply click on the goods or items while holding down the Ctrl key.
Did you know that you can collapse the loading ramp view of any Trading Post? This will afford you more space to see what goods are stored there.
Want to compare islands in the statistics menu? Use "Ctrl" or "Shift" to select multiple islands.

Did you know you can choose to be notified as soon as a ship has reached its target position? Simply activate the bell button before giving it the move command. This is handy if you want to know when it's arrived at a trader, or a new island.
Hovering over a production building in the construction menu will show its production rate. If one factory is slower than another that depends on it, consider building another to compensate.
All warehouses and trading posts located on the same island share the same storage. Once a good reaches a warehouse, it can be transferred to any nearby ship or factory that requires it.
Stay in touch with your residents' needs. Your ever-growing population may need more bread or fish than you can currently provide.
Being able to idenitfy a shortage can prove very useful to managing a thriving city! The production tab in the statistics menu allows you to closely monitor your production and consumption.

If you don't keep your people warm in the Arctic, they'll be more likely to suffer from illnesses. Heaters have a limited heat radius, and require a constant supply of coal.
Gas power stations are more efficient. Harness gas in the Arctic, and build power stations that don't even require a railway connection!
Deep Gold Mines and Prime Hunting Cabins in the Arctic produce more resources than their Old World counterparts.
If you run low on coal in the Arctic, don't forget that you can bring in extra coal from other regions!
Hover over a Policy in the Palace menu to highlight all the buildings it affects.
Building additional wings increases the range of the Palace's main building. Increasing your Global Population will allow you to build more wings.
Increase your city's attractiveness to unlock more Palace Policies.
For the Palace to affect a Harbourmaster's Office, the two buildings need to be connected by a road and within range of each other. That means the Palace must be built by the shore.
Remember that the shape of your Palace does not affect its range! Palace range is determined purely by the number of Palace Wings you've built.
Once all Palace Policies have been unlocked, you'll gain prestige levels as your attractiveness level increases. Prestige enhances department effects even further!
Did you know there's a shortcut for changing the appearance of buildings like ornaments, residences or palace wings? You can customise it from the options menu!
Local Departments depend upon the Palace: you can only select departments and policies that you've unlocked in the Palace.
You cannot build a Local Department on the same island as your Palace or other Local Departments.
Silos and tractors can be added to farms in other regions too, not just the Old World!
Silos will use the local crops in each region. In the Old World, for example, silos require grain to function, while in the New World, they consume corn.
If your silo runs out of fodder, you'll lose its effects on your farm, but beyond that, your farm will continue to produce at its usual rate.
If your tractors run out of fuel, you'll lose their effects on your farm, but beyond than that, your farm will continue to produce at its usual rate.
You can combine the irrigation capacity of two or more water pumps if you connect them via canals.
All buildings built in river slots function on both shores: you can connect canals and streets to either side of the building.
In Enbesa, the main farm building does not need to be placed on irrigated soil — only its fields!

Did you know that you can queue several item developments or major discoveries in the Research Institute? Just press "Add to Queue", and it will automatically be developed when all others are finished - if you have enough research points.
Trader Captain Tobias will visit your docklands regularly, bringing your requested import goods and loading your export goods into his astoundingly vast cargo holds!

As you export increased amounts of specific goods, your Exporter Level in those goods will increase, meaning you'll get better exchange ratios when exporting them in future. In addition, your docklands module limit will increase for that island!
Did you know docklands modules don't need to be directly connected to the main building to be functional? It does help with Attractiveness, though.
Captain Tobias is an expert seafarer, a tradesman well versed in long hauls, yarns from all across the seven seas and the fathomless intricacies of the game of cricket.
With Export/Import Contracts from the Docklands, you can cleverly import raw materials, refine them in your factories, and reinvest the end product for different import goods.
While initially small, your docklands will evolve into a sprawling, rich complex. It would be wise to choose a fittingly large - and equally sparsely populated - harbour area to build it in.
Each Trading Partner has a unique set of goods on offer for trade. Some may even offer new goods to trade if they find conditions in your city suit their brand's personality.

Your Docklands Main Wharf is not just the heart of your soon-to-be world-famous docklands complex — it also has the same abilities as a Harbourmaster's Office, but with a far larger area of influence.
Happy Tourists attract more Tourists! Only by ensuring your Tourists are happy can you make their basic needs sufficient enough to attract more tourists and fill your hotels.

Bus stops are connected if their green street overlay overlaps. Keep bus stops close to the buildings you want to connect to, as the closer a building is to the bus network, the better it will fulfill that need.

Tourists will be satisfied with any recipe used in a Restaurant, Bar or Café. Changing recipes, however, will allow you to use different core goods, and generate different effects on the population in the building's area of influence — so be sure to try out different dishes!
Although restaurants, cafés and bars have a similar effect to public services, they need to be constantly fuelled with input goods to work, so be sure to have a warehouse nearby!

Restaurants, Cafés and Bars need their tourist customers in order to fully satisfy their respective needs. If they don't have enough customers, they won't be able to satisfy the tourist's needs, nor will their effect on the local population be maximised.
Did you know that every restaurant, café, bar and even bus stop can be renamed to further customise your city?

Whatever inexperience the Tourist may have in the ways of the world, she more than makes up for it with her drive, enthusiasm and determination to seek out the pleasures of a life of leisure and adventure! This is not just an outing: it's a chance a tasting the freedom of the wide, wide world — starting with your city!
Skyscrapers, including the Skyline Tower, have significant maintenance costs because of their daring structure. Manage your income and expenditure carefully!
For skyscraper residents, any design patent in the Shopping Arcades will do. You should only switch patents to use up other input goods, or apply different effects on the surrounding population.
Shopping Arcades are a special building type: they act like public services, but consume input goods. Make sure you have a warehouse close by!

You can create a Panorama Effect on any skyscraper: the more smaller skyscrapers there are around it, the stronger the effect will be. Just imagine you're giving the residents of the taller skyscrapers unobstructed views!
Hold Shift while having a skyscraper selected to see all skyscrapers on the same level.

When a ship is within range of your trading post, you can transfer or sell any ship cargo by using Ctrl+Shift+Left Click. If a target storage is full, goods remain on the ship. Use Ctrl+Shift+Right Click to throw cargo overboard.

Turn your cities into travel destinations, with Hotels attracting a new Tourist residential tier! Open Restaurants, Cafés and Bars to impress guests and locals alike with your menus. Connect Tourists by bus to the Hotspots of your city, including a brand-new Monument inspired by one of the greatest structures of the industrial age, the Eiffel Tower!

Turn cities into travel destinations, with the Tourist residential tier and Hotels! Open Restaurants, Cafés and Bars and customise your menus to revitalize your cities. Connect Tourists by bus to Hotspots, including a new Monument inspired by the Eiffel Tower!
Hotels & Tourists
Build Hotels across your islands to accommodate the new tourists. Make sure to fulfill the picky tourists' needs to attract more and more.
Restaurants, Cafés and Bars
Challenge the taste buds of Tourists and other residents with a variety of Recipes.
The Iron Tower' Monument
Raise a majestic landmark to honour the Queen herself, and curate the menu inside it at the world-famous "Restaurant La Reine"
Tour Buses
Construct an elaborate bus network, with bus stops that connect hotels to the hotspots and sights of your island.
Tourism-themed Ornaments
A scenic assortment of delights that a Tourist might expect to find in the most beautiful cities of the world.

Live the high life with towering new skyscrapers and their panoramas! Get your residents to dip their hands into their pockets with shopping arcades! Sell products created from homeware, furniture and pharmacy patents developed by you! But be sure to save some downtown real estate for the whopping Skyline Tower monument, inspired by Chicago and Manhattan — Anno's highest ever structure!

Towering new skyscrapers and panoramas! Shopping arcades selling products from homeware, furniture and pharmacy patents developed by you! And don't forget the brand new Skyline Tower monument, Anno's highest ever structure!
Skyscrapers
Build towering skyscrapers for your elite engineers and investors.
Shopping Arcades
Sell new patented products in fancy malls that cater to the latest high-end trends
New Production Chains
New factories and new goods in both the Old World and New World.
The Skyline Tower
Leaning against the clouds, the imposing Skyline Tower is the ultimate ambition of every great industrialist.
Up, Up, And Away!
A host of lighter-than-air new ornaments to really give your city a lift!

Begin an agricultural revolution in the New World with the modular hacienda! Expand and beautify your estate, enact island-wide edicts, and use fertiliser to improve the productivity of your farms. Also includes the Seasons of Silver scenario: playing as Vasco Oliveira, brave extreme weather and punishing deadlines to establish a royal mint in a remote region.
Revolutionise agriculture in the New World with the modular hacienda! Expand and beautify your estate, enact edicts, and boost your farms with fertiliser.
Hacienda
Govern in style with the hacienda! Build valuable modular buildings, beautify your estate with thematic ornaments, and enact edicts to optimise your playstyle.
Hacienda Modules
Concoct a variety of drinks for your people at the brewery, plant crops of your choosing with the new space-efficient farm, and produce powerful fertiliser to boost your agriculture.
Hacienda Ornaments
Create a beautiful estate and nail the hacienda aesthetic with ornaments including white stucco walls, gateways, and colonnades.
Seasons of Silver Scenario
Playing as Vasco Oliveira, establish a silver mint in a remote region, while battling changing seasons and punishing deadlines.

Take your Anno experience to new heights with Empire of the Skies! With your mighty fleet of airships, you can easily transport goods, items, and workers between your islands, connect your people with the post system, and rain destruction upon your enemies. Also includes a brand-new scenario, featuring aviation pioneer Paloma Valente!
Take both your logistical and tactical planning to new heights with a fleet of mighty airships!
Rigid Airships
Modular Airship Platform
Postal System
Ornaments
Scenario: 'A Clash of Couriers'
Paloma Valente gets more than she bargained for when she enters the Grand Postal Derby! Compete against a host of familiar characters to establish the greatest delivery network ever seen.
Five new helium-based airships are available to build. Some are faster, some are more spacious, and some can be armed for airship-to-airship combat!
Integral to your airship infrastructure is the new platform, with modular additions for airmail, easy item transfer, and workforce transport.
Connect the citizens of your far-flung empire with the new airmail system. Master the delivery system and gain a variety of benefits!
Your airship platform isn't just a logistical hub — it's a place for your citizens to revel in the wonder of flight. Decorate it accordingly!

Ring in the age of innovation, as the New World rises to the challenges of a new era. Attract a new resident tier and cook up a perfect storm of local delicacies. Explore an expanded map and create a tropical paradise with the technology of a gilded age – and sunny beaches. Host football championships at your stadium, or prove yourself in a match of wits, unveiling Madame Kahina’s mysterious past in the latest scenario.
Usher in the industrial era in the New World, explore new islands and endless possibilities!
Map Expansion
The Artista
A New Palette
Beach Ornaments
The Grand Stadium
Host football games in style in this modern, visionary monument, and reap the rewards of a successful season!
The world just got a whole lot bigger! To the south, a colourful continental island awaits your visit – among others.
This new resident tier is full of sass! Uniquely gifted, they've come up with a series of impressive inventions, and have an insatiable taste for life and its many delights!
Explore the riches of the New World, and claim its treasures from the seas and the soil with new production chains. Also adds a new twist to traditional farms.
Walking on sunshine? Adorn your beaches with this unique set of ornaments, and it won't be only the ice cream that melts!
Scenario: 'Pride & Peddlers'

Madame Kahina and the cheeky artista embark on a quest to save the ancient artifacts of the New World in this trader’s tale. But all is not what it seems... Master the markets to expose a secret better left unspoken.

Influence
Influence is a global currency that can be invested in different ways.

When starting out, some categories of investment grant you a limited amount of free Influence to build and buy with. Consider it your startup capital.

You only pay Influence for actions or objects belonging to a category once you have passed that category’s free limit.

Example:
The first ten Zoo modules only cost coins. Any module beyond that costs coins and Influence.
Building Zoos (Culture category) doesn’t affect free Influence available in the Trade category.
Influence you spent on buildings or actions will be refunded if you destroy/cancel them.
Influence you spent on buildings or actions will be refunded if you destroy/cancel them.
Influence - Sources & Bonuses
Sources of Influence

You gain Influence from two sources:

* Global Population
* Investor Residences
Influence - Bonuses

You can unlock bonuses when investing in a certain category (e.g. Culture, Trade).

All requirements and active bonuses are listed on the second page of the Influence tab.

The foundation of something monumental. This vast dig site marks the first step in the journey towards the World's Fair, an exhibition space to dwarf all other celebrations of human endeavour.
The World's Fair is beginning to take shape: the foundations have been laid, the scaffolding erected, and now the walls are springing up. Anticipation is building!
With the World's Fair superstructure almost complete, careful work has begun on the distinctive glass and steel canopy that will make this grand exhibition hall so very unique.
The waiting is nearly at an end! The World's Fair needs only electricity, insulation and a few last-minute touches to its majestic roof, before the ribbon can be cut to a triumphant fanfare!
Access World's Fair
In order to blow a way through to Ditchwater's iron deposits, these abandoned tunnels will first need to be secured with scaffolding, before any explosive charges can be placed.
With the tunnels now secured with scaffolding, an expert in demolitions is needed to make sure the dynamite is all correctly wired and strategically placed!
An empty plot of land chosen by the Queen herself as the prime location for the Empire's flagship Court of Justice, upon completion of which the nefarious traitor Edvard Goode is to stand trial.
The steel framework for the new Court of Justice is near complete, as are the foundations of the wings. Already, it is beginning to look like an edifice of integrity and incorruptibility.
The Queen's new courthouse is missing only a roof, and skylights through which the divine rays of justice may flood, exposing all who would dare to betray her.

A young painter sits alone in his vast, vast workshop. He wishes he could trade the painted flowers for their actual fragrant selves, but he cannot, for his every waking moment must be spent in service of his art.
The painter was devoted to his art, but his strokes failed to invoke the real world. So one day, the painter chose to abandon the brush, and engaged in a walk in the shade of the orchard.
The washerwoman quivered at the glimpse of her beloved above the hedge. "This will be my only chance", she told herself, "either he'll notice me now, or he'll notice me never".
